artifacts.name: 'What is Magic' by Archmage Tarelion
artifacts.nameZh: 大法师泰尔兰关于“什么是魔法”的演讲
artifacts.desc: Lecture on the nature of magic by Archmage Tarelion.
artifacts.descZh: 大法师泰尔兰关于魔法本质的演讲

artifacts.name: "Dust to Dust", an undead hunter's guide, by Aslabor Borys
artifacts.nameZh: “尘归尘”，不死猎人指南，作者：阿斯拉伯·波利斯
artifacts.desc: An undead hunter's guide, by Aslabor Borys.
artifacts.descZh: 不死猎人指南，作者：阿斯拉伯·波利斯

artifacts.name: a logical analysis of creation, by philosopher Smythen
artifacts.nameZh: 创世传说的逻辑分析，哲学家斯迈森著
artifacts.desc: Myth of creation of the halflings.
artifacts.descZh: 半身人的创世传说。

artifacts.name: Acera
artifacts.desc: This warped, blackened sword drips acid from its countless pores.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄扭曲的黑刀从无数小孔中滴落酸液。

artifacts.name: Aetherwalk
artifacts.desc: A wispy purple aura surrounds these translucent black boots.
artifacts.descZh: 一圈紫色光环围绕着这双半透明的黑色靴子。

usePower.name: phase door up to range 6, within radius 2 of the target location
usePower.nameZh: 传送到6码范围内的地点，误差在两码范围内。

specialDesc.en: Creates an arcane explosion dealing %d arcane damage based on magic in a radius of 3 around the user after any teleport.
specialDesc.zh: 使用者传送后，在周围3码范围内造成奥术爆发，造成%d奥术伤害，伤害基于魔力值。

artifacts.name: Aletta's Diadem
artifacts.desc:
A filigree of silver set with many small jewels, this diadem seems radiant - ethereal almost. But its touch seems to freeze your skin and brings wild thoughts to your mind. You want to drop it, throw it away, and yet you cannot resist thinking of what powers it might bring you.
Is this temptation a weak will on your part, or some domination from the artifact itself...?
artifacts.descZh:
一个镶嵌有很多珠宝的银制艺术品，这顶王冠看起来光芒四射而又美丽优雅。但是当你碰到它时，你感到你的皮肤都要冻僵了，许多狂暴的意识涌向你的大脑。你想丢弃它，扔掉它，但是你最终无法抗拒它能带给你的力量。
是你的意志太薄弱，还是这件神器支配了你？

artifacts.name: Amethyst of Sanctuary
artifacts.desc: This bright violet gem exudes a calming, focusing force. Holding it, you feel protected against outside forces.
artifacts.descZh: 这颗明亮的紫色宝石渗透出宁静、专注的力量，当你紧握它时，你可以感受到它保护你与外界力量隔绝。

specialDesc.en: Reduce damage from attackers more than 3 tiles away by 25%
specialDesc.zh: 来自3格外的敌人造成的伤害降低25%。

artifacts.name: Amulet of Mindpower (+3)
artifacts.desc: A beautiful amulet that increases your Mindpower by 3.
artifacts.descZh: 可以提高你3点精神强度的项链。

artifacts.name: Anmalice
artifacts.desc: The eye on the hilt of this blade seems to glare at you, piercing your soul and mind. Tentacles surround the hilt, latching onto your hand.
artifacts.descZh: 剑柄上的眼睛似乎直视着你，试图撕裂你的灵魂。剑柄上环绕的触手可以使其很好的固定在你手上。

items.value: torments the target with many mental effects
reduces mental save penalty

artifacts.name: Annihilator
artifacts.desc: This gun features a wheel with several barrels attached and seems to be powered by an engine. It looks... impressive.
artifacts.descZh: 这把枪的转轮上附有多支枪管，看起来由引擎驱动。看起来令人印象深刻。

specialDesc.en: Fire rate increases while firing, up to 5 shots per turn. Resets after 5 turns without firing.
specialDesc.zh: 攻击频率随着射击而增加，一回合最多射5次。5回合未射击则效果消失。

items.value: 50% chance to reload 1 ammo

artifacts.name: Anti-Gravity Boots
artifacts.desc:
These boots seem to have been made by a... creative individual who seems to have decided that launching yourself through the air via rocketry qualifies as "anti-gravity".
They look like they will work, though.
Probably.
If you're very careful.
artifacts.descZh:
这套鞋子似乎是被一位具有……创造力的大师制造出来的，他似乎认为用火箭将你发射到空中就是“反重力”了。
看上去这套鞋子能用，大概。
确实有可能。
只要你非常非常小心。

usePower.name: jump to a nearby location within range %d, blasting everything within radius 2 (%d burning fire damage, 2 tile knockback) of the jump point and within radius 3 (%d burning fire damage, 3 tile knockback) of the landing point (damage based on Cunning)
usePower.nameZh: 跳向半径%d码范围内的地点，轰炸起跳点附近半径2码范围内的所有敌人 (%d 火焰燃烧伤害，击退2格)以及落地点附近半径3码范围的所有敌人 (%d 火焰燃烧伤害，击退3格)（伤害随灵巧值提升）

specialDesc.en: These boots have a %d%% chance to fail to operate properly (reduced by Cunning).
specialDesc.zh: 火箭靴有%d%%几率失败(随灵巧降低)。

artifacts.name: Antimagic Wyrm Bile Extract
artifacts.desc: This potent elixir extracted from a powerful wyrm can grant the power to repel arcane forces.
artifacts.descZh: 这种强大的药剂提取自一头龙的龙胆，可以给予你对抗魔法的力量。

artifacts.name: Arkul's Siege Arrows
artifacts.desc: These titanic double-helical arrows seem to have been designed more for knocking down towers than for use in regular combat. They'll no doubt make short work of most foes.
artifacts.descZh: 巨大的双螺旋箭，似乎是为推倒高塔而非常规战斗设计。毫无疑问,它们会迅速干掉敌人。

specialDesc.en: 25% of all damage splashes in a radius of 1 around the target.
specialDesc.zh: 你造成的伤害的25%溅射在目标周围1格

artifacts.name: Assassin's Surprise
artifacts.desc: These steel gauntlets feature a hidden contraption embedded in the left index finger that fires poisonous bolts.
artifacts.descZh: 这对铁手套左手大拇指处有一个精巧的毒箭发射机关。

usePower.name: fire a poisonous bolt out to range %d that deals %d nature damage and afflicts the target with crippling poison (%d%% fail chance) that deals %d addition nature damage over %d turns (damage based on Cunning)
usePower.nameZh: 朝%d码外的敌人发射毒液，造成%d自然伤害，并导致目标被致残毒素(%d%% 行动失败几率)，在%d回合内造成%d额外自然伤害（伤害受灵巧值加成）

artifacts.name: Astelrid's Clubstaff
artifacts.nameZh: 治疗师亚斯特莉的“狼牙棒”
artifacts.desc: Like its former owner, this was once an instrument of altruistic healing, before fury and fear caused its twisting into a sadistic weapon.  Surges of restorative magic can be faintly felt under the layers of plaster and sharp surgical equipment.
artifacts.descZh: 如同它的前任主人一样，这曾经是无私治愈的工具，然而愤怒和恐惧将其扭曲成一把嗜血的武器。在插着锋利的手术设备的石膏涂层下，依稀可以感觉到流淌而出的治疗魔法的力量

specialDesc.en: Improves the contribution of primary stats on infusions and runes by 15%
specialDesc.zh: 增加符文和纹身的属性加成效果15%

artifacts.name: Awakened Staff of Absorption
artifacts.desc:
Carved with runes of power, this staff seems to have been made long ago, yet it bears no signs of tarnish.
Light around it seems to dim and you can feel its tremendous power simply by touching it.
The Sorcerers seem to have awakened its power.
#{italic}#"And lo they came to Amakthel himself, and thousands were killed in the assault on his throne, and three of the Godslayers were broken beneath his feet. But Falion with his dying breath pierced the great god on his knee with the icy sword Arkil, and seeing his opportunity Caldizar, leader of the Godslayers, advanced with the Staff of Absorption and struck a terrifying blow against Amakthel. So fell the greatest of the gods by the hands of his own children, and his face was forced into the dust."#{normal}#
artifacts.descZh:
杖身铭刻着符文，这根法杖似乎是很久以前制造的，虽然它毫无侵蚀的痕迹。它周围的光线会变的暗淡，当你触摸它时可以感受到惊人的魔力。
恶魔法师们似乎唤醒了它的力量。
#{italic}#“终于他们直面了阿马克泰尔，并且上千人牺牲在了他的王座前，其中有三名弑神者倒在了他的脚下。但是法利恩用他死前最后的力量将冰刃阿奇尔插入了真神的膝盖，看到这一机会，凯尔帝勒，弑神者的首领，立刻上前并用吸能法杖对阿马克泰尔造成了致命的一击。这样真神最终倒在了他自己的儿女手中，他的头颅也化作了尘埃。”#{normal}#

usePower.name: absorb the essence (ignoring resistance and bypassing most defenses) of a target in range %d, draining 30%% of its life and increasing your own damage by 30%% for %d turns
usePower.nameZh: 吸收%d码范围内某个目标生物的精华（无视抗性和大部分防御技能），直接吸收30%%生命值，并增加自身伤害加成30%%，持续%d回合

artifacts.name: Band of Protection
artifacts.desc: This belt utilizes an enchanted gem to focus a burst of steam into a powerful barrier.
artifacts.descZh: 这个腰带使用强化的宝石，将涌出的蒸汽聚集萎一个强力的屏障。

usePower.name: generate a personal shield that absorbs up to %d damage and damages attackers striking the wearer for %d fire damage while it lasts (based on Cunning)
usePower.nameZh: 产生护盾，吸收%d伤害。在护盾破裂前，所有攻击穿戴者的人会受到%d火焰伤害（基于灵巧值）

artifacts.name: Behemoth Hide
artifacts.desc: A rough hide made from a massive beast.  Seeing as it's so weathered but still usable, maybe it's a bit special...
artifacts.descZh: 一张取自巨型猛兽的粗制兽皮。鉴于它已经被风吹日晒了这么久还能凑合用用，没准会有一点特别的……

artifacts.name: Bikini
artifacts.desc:
Revealing, pink, fun.
#{bold}#If you never take it off and win you will gain a neat achievement and bragging rights!#{normal}#
artifacts.descZh:
性感，粉色，有趣。
#{bold}#如果你在全程不脱下它的情况下通关你将可以得到一个成就和吹牛的权利！#{normal}#

specialDesc.en: You have never taken it off.
specialDesc.zh: 你还没有把它脱下过。

artifacts.name: Bill's Tree Trunk
artifacts.desc: This is a big, nasty-looking tree trunk that Bill the Troll used as a weapon. It could still serve this purpose, should you be strong enough to wield it!
artifacts.descZh: 这是一个巨大的、丑陋的树干，但是巨魔比尔把它当做武器。如果你够强壮，你也可以把它当做武器！

artifacts.name: Bindings of Eternal Night
artifacts.desc: Woven through with fell magics of undeath, these bindings suck the light and life out of everything they touch. Any who don them will find themselves suspended in a nightmarish limbo between life and death.
artifacts.descZh: 这根由亡灵能量编织成的绷带，给任何它们接触到的东西带来死亡。任何穿上它们的人会发现他处于生死的边缘。

artifacts.name: Bizzare Contraption
artifacts.desc: This strange device appears to be entirely mechanical in nature, but you cannot understand how any of the components are supposed to work. There does appear to be some sort of metallic grid in its side which sometimes emits strange noises.
artifacts.descZh: 这个奇怪的装置看上去是完全机械制的，但是你根本不明白这些组件到底是怎么工作的。在它的侧面有着某种金属的网格，有时会发出奇怪的噪声。

artifacts.name: Black Mesh
artifacts.desc: Black, interwoven tendrils form this mesh that can be used as a shield. It reacts visibly to your touch, clinging to your arm and engulfing it in a warm, black mass.
artifacts.descZh: 盾牌由许多黑色的触须交织而成。当你触摸它时，你可以感受它非常明显的反应，它缠绕住你的手臂并将其包裹在一团黑色而温暖的物质中。

artifacts.name: Black Robe
artifacts.desc: A silk robe, darker than the darkest night sky, it radiates power.
artifacts.descZh: 一件比夜色还黑的丝绸礼服，它向外辐射出能量。

artifacts.name: Blackfire Aegis
artifacts.desc: This rugged stone shield flickers with bursts of pitch black flame.
artifacts.descZh: 这个坚固的石盾闪烁着漆黑的火焰。

items.value: releases a burst of dark fire, dealing damage equal to your magic stat

artifacts.name: Blade of Distorted Time
artifacts.desc: The remnants of a damaged timeline, this blade shifts and fades at random.
artifacts.descZh: 这把剑由一段损坏的时间线构成，它在不断的出入相位现实。

artifacts.name: Bladed Rift
artifacts.desc: Upon defeat, Ak'Gishil collapsed into this tiny rift. How it remains stable, you are unsure. If you focus, you think you can call forth a sword from it.
artifacts.descZh: 在击败阿克·吉希尔后，它留下了这个小巧的裂隙。你无从知道，它是如何保持这样的稳定状态。冥冥中你感受到，你能从这个裂隙中召唤出一把剑。

artifacts.name: Blighted Maul
artifacts.desc: The massive stone limb of the Rotting Titan, a mass of stone and rotting flesh. You think you can lift it, but it is very heavy.
artifacts.descZh: 这是腐化泰坦的一部分沉重肢体，一大块腐烂的石化躯体。你认为你可以轻易举起它，但事实证明，它重的不可思议。

usePower.name: knock away other creatures within radius %d), dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Strength) to each
usePower.nameZh: 击退半径 %d 的生物，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 物理伤害(基于力量)。

artifacts.name: Blightstopper
artifacts.desc: This voratun shield, coated with thick vines, was imbued with nature's power long ago by the Halfling General Almadar Riul, who used it to stave off the magic and diseases of orcish corruptors during the peak of the Pyre Wars.
artifacts.descZh: 这块沃瑞钽盾牌表面被厚实的藤蔓所缠绕，其中注入了许多年前的半身人将军阿尔曼达·鲁伊尔的自然力量，他在派尔之战中用这个盾牌驱散了兽人堕落者的魔法疫病。

usePower.name: purge up to %d diseases (based on Willpower) and gain disease immunity, %d%% blight resistance, and %d spell save for 5 turns
usePower.nameZh: 除去至多 %d 项疾病（基于意志 ) 并获得疾病免疫、%d%% 枯萎抗性和 %d 法术豁免 5 回合。

artifacts.name: Blood of Life
artifacts.desc: This vial of blood was drawn from an ancient race in the Age of Haze. Some of the power and vitality of those early days of the world still flows through it. "Drink me, mortal," the red liquid seems to whisper in your thoughts. "I will bring you light beyond darkness. Those who taste my essence fear not the death of flesh. Drink me, mortal, if you value your life..."
artifacts.descZh: 这瓶血液是在混沌纪某个古老种族的身上抽取的。在那个世界的古老时代流动着的能量和生命，仍然在瓶子中流动。“喝下我吧，凡人”，这瓶红色的液体仿佛在你的耳边低语“我会给你带来超越黑暗的光芒。品尝我精华的人将永远不会害怕肉体的死亡。喝下我吧，凡人，如果你珍惜你的生命的话…”

artifacts.name: Blood of Undeath
artifacts.desc: This vial of corrupted blood reeks of death and decay. Yet somehow you feel drawn to it... Is it the tentalizing notion of eternal life? Or power? You can not tell, but the urge to drink it is great.
artifacts.descZh: 这瓶腐败的血散发着死亡和腐烂的气味。但不知怎的，你觉得被它吸引了……这，就是永恒生命的具象化吗？还是强大的力量？你说不出来，但你充满了想喝它的冲动。

artifacts.name: Blood-Edge
artifacts.desc:
This deep red sword weeps blood continuously. It was born in the labs of the orcish corrupter Hurik, who sought to make a crystal that would house his soul after death. But his plans were disrupted by a band of sun paladins, and though most died purging his keep of dread minions, their leader Raasul fought through to Hurik's lab, sword in hand. There the two did battle, blade against blood magic, till both fell to the floor with weeping wounds. The orc with his last strength crawled towards his fashioned phylactery, hoping to save himself, but Raasul saw his plans and struck the crystal with his light-bathed sword. It shattered, and in the sudden impulse of energies the steel, crystal and blood were fused into one.
Now the broken fragments of Raasul's soul are trapped in this terrible artifact, his mind warped beyond all sanity by decades of imprisonment. Only the taste of blood calls him forth, his soul stealing the lifeblood of others to take on physical form again, that he may thrash and wail against the living.
artifacts.descZh:
这把深红色的剑不断的向下滴血。它诞生于兽人堕落者胡里克的实验室。最初，胡里克寻找了一枚水晶来制造他的命匣，但他的计划很快被一群太阳骑士打断，尽管大部分骑士死于不死军团的阻拦，但骑士团团长瑞苏尔却单枪匹马杀入了胡里克的实验室。在那里，两位强者展开了对决，利剑与血魔法你来我往，直到他们都重伤倒地。兽人想拼尽最后一分力气，拿到他的命匣，希望能拯救自己，但是瑞苏尔识破了他的阴谋，将浸满鲜血的利剑掷向了命匣。命匣破碎的瞬间，胡里克的灵魂和利剑以及水晶融为了一体。
现在，残存的胡里克灵魂被困在了这件可怕的武器中，他的思维因数十年的监禁而扭曲。只有鲜血的味道能引起他的兴奋，他的灵魂在不断的侵蚀他人的血肉，希望有朝一日能够重组自我，摆脱这痛苦的存在形式。

items.value: 15% chance to animate a bleeding foe's blood

artifacts.name: Blood-Letter
artifacts.desc: A hand axe carved out of the most frozen parts of the northern wasteland.
artifacts.descZh: 用北部荒原的寒冰之核雕成的手斧。

artifacts.name: Bloodcaller
artifacts.desc: You won the Ring of Blood trial, and this is your reward.
artifacts.descZh: 你赢得了鲜血之环的试炼，这是对你的奖赏。

specialDesc.en:
You heal for 2.5%% of the damage you deal.
Healing during current combat:  #GREEN#%0.2f#LAST#
specialDesc.zh:
你造成的所有伤害将会回复你相当于伤害值2.5%%的生命值。
在本次战斗中的回复量： #GREEN#%0.2f#LAST#

artifacts.name: Bloomsoul
artifacts.desc: Pristine flowers coat the surface of this mindstar. Touching it fills you with a sense of calm and refreshes your body.
artifacts.descZh: 纯洁的花瓣覆盖着灵晶，当你触摸它时你感受到宁静和清新。

artifacts.name: Bolbum's Big Knocker
artifacts.desc: A thick staff with a heavy knob on the end.  It was said to be used by the grand alchemist Bolbum in the Age of Allure.  Much renowned is the fear of his students for their master, and the high rate of cranial injuries amongst them.  Bolbum died with seven daggers in his back and his much-cursed staff went missing after.
artifacts.descZh: 这是一根末端有着厚重门扣的沉重法杖。据说是炼金魔导师鲍尔本在厄流纪使用的法杖。它之所以闻名于世，大部分来源于鲍尔本的学生们对他的恐惧以及被它打伤脑袋的超高几率。鲍尔本被7把匕首插在后背而死，那根被众人诅咒的法杖也从此消失不见。

artifacts.name: Boots of Physical Save (+10)
artifacts.desc: Fine boots that increase your Physical Save by 10.
artifacts.descZh: 可以提高你10点物理豁免的好靴。

artifacts.name: Boots of the Hunter
artifacts.desc: These cracked boots are caked with a thick layer of mud. It isn't clear who they previously belonged to, but they've clearly seen extensive use.
artifacts.descZh: 这对有裂缝的靴子涂着厚厚的一层泥浆。目前还不清楚它以前属于谁,但显然,它曾被很多人使用过。

usePower.name: boost movement speed by 300% for up to 5 turns (or until you perform a non-movement action)
usePower.nameZh: 增加移动速度300%五回合。（任何非移动行动会打断这个效果）

artifacts.name: Borfast's Cage
artifacts.unidedName: a suit of pitted and pocked plate-mail
artifacts.desc:
Inch-thick stralite plates lock together with voratun joints. The whole suit looks impenetrable, but has clearly been subjected to terrible treatment - great dents and misshaping warps, and caustic fissures bored across the surface.
Though clearly a powerful piece, it must once have been much greater.
artifacts.descZh:
英尺厚的蓝锆石板甲，关节部分由沃瑞钽组成。整套铠甲看起来异常坚固，但是显然它有过非常可怕的经历——巨大的凹痕、扭曲的关节以及腐蚀的表面。
尽管现在看起来只是一块坚固的铁板，但是它显然有着辉煌的过去。

artifacts.name: Borosk's Hate
artifacts.desc: This impressive looking sword features two massive blades aligned in parallel. They seem weighted remarkably well.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄剑令人印象深刻，因为它有两个平行刀锋。

items.value: 25% chance to strike the target again.

artifacts.name: Brass Goggles
artifacts.desc: No self respecting craftsman would be caught without them!
artifacts.descZh: 没有任何一个自爱的工匠会被人发现没有佩戴它！

artifacts.name: Breath of Eyal
artifacts.desc: This lightweight armor appears to have been woven of countless sprouts, still curling and growing. When you put it on, you feel the weight of the world on your shoulders, in spite of how light it feels in your hands.
artifacts.descZh: 这件护甲由数以千计的豆芽缠绕编成，豆芽们仍在不停的生长缠绕。尽管在你手里很轻，但当穿上它时，你感觉到肩上那世界一般的重量。

artifacts.name: Brilliant Auto-loading Orc Expeller
artifacts.nameZh: 自动充能式兽人驱逐装置
artifacts.desc: A finely crafted gun, designed specifically to kill orcs. And giants somehow!
artifacts.descZh: 精心打造的枪，专为杀兽人而设计。偶尔也杀杀巨人。

artifacts.name: Brilliant Auto-loading Orc Expeller
artifacts.nameZh: 自动充能式兽人驱逐装置
artifacts.desc: A finely crafted gun, designed specifically to kill orcs. And giants somehow!
artifacts.descZh: 精心打造的枪，专为杀兽人而设计。偶尔也杀杀巨人。

artifacts.name: Burning Star
artifacts.desc:
The first Halfling mages during the Age of Allure discovered how to capture the Sunlight and infuse gems with it.
This star is the culmination of their craft. Light radiates from its ever-shifting yellow surface.
artifacts.descZh: 第一个发现如何将日光捕获并注入宝石之中的人是厄流纪的一个半身人大法师。这颗宝石是他们的工艺结晶。光芒从宝石那玲珑剔透的黄色表面放射出来。

usePower.name: map surroundings within range 20
usePower.nameZh: 揭示周围20码的地形

artifacts.name: Butcher
artifacts.desc: Be it corruption, madness or eccentric boredom, the halfling butcher by the name of Caleb once took to eating his kin instead of cattle. His spree was never ended and nobody knows where he disappeared to. Only the blade remained, stuck fast in a bloodied block. Beneath, a carving said "This was fun, let's do it again some time."
artifacts.descZh: 或许是堕落，或许是疯狂，半身人屠夫凯莱布杀死他的亲戚代替牲口。他的疯狂还没有停止，他的人影却已经不见，只留下这把刀刃，留在了血泊之中。下面刻着一行字“真有趣，下次再试试”

specialDesc.en: Enter Rampage if health falls below 20%%%s
specialDesc.zh: 当生命值降低到20%%%s时，进入暴走。

items.value: Attempt to devour a low HP enemy, striking again and possibly killing it instantly.
Enter a Rampage (Shared cooldown).

artifacts.name: Cautery Sword
artifacts.desc: This sword is equipped with a heated core to add a bit of extra pain to the wounds.
artifacts.descZh: 这把剑的炽热核心可以让敌人的伤口感到更加疼痛。

items.value: inflict fire damage based on steampower

artifacts.name: Celia's Still Beating Heart
artifacts.desc: The living heart of the necromancer Celia, carved out of her chest and preserved with magic.
artifacts.descZh: 死灵法师赛利亚的跳动心脏，取自她的胸膛，上面充满了魔法的力量。

usePower.name: extract a tiny part of Celia's soul
usePower.nameZh: 抽取希利娅灵魂的一小块

artifacts.name: Champion's Will
artifacts.desc: This impressive looking sword features a golden engraving of a sun in its hilt. Etched into its blade are a series of runes claiming that only one who has mastered both their body and mind may wield this sword effectively.
artifacts.descZh: 初看这把外形令人印象深刻的长剑，最先吸引你目光的是雕刻在剑柄之中的金色太阳。而蚀刻在剑刃之上的复杂的符文仿佛在告诉你，只有真正掌握自己肉体和精神力量之人才能发挥出这把武器的最大威力。

usePower.name: attack everything in a line out to range %d, dealing 100%% weapon damage (as light), and healing for 50%% of the damage dealt
usePower.nameZh: 攻击长度为 %d 的直线上所有目标 , 造成 100%% 光系武器伤  害,  并将 50%% 伤害转化为治疗。

specialDesc.en: Increases the damage of Sun Beam by 15%.
specialDesc.zh: 增加15%阳光烈焰伤害

artifacts.name: Charged Focus
artifacts.desc: Electrical energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
artifacts.descZh: 电能集中在这个灵晶的核心里.

artifacts.name: Choker of Dread
artifacts.desc: The evilness of undeath radiates from this amulet.
artifacts.descZh: 这件护符散发着不死生物的邪恶气息。

usePower.name: summon an elder vampire with Taunt to your side for 15 turns
usePower.nameZh: 召唤一个会使用嘲讽的吸血鬼长老为你服务15回合。

artifacts.name: Chromatic Harness
artifacts.desc: This dragon scale harness shines with multiple colors, quickly shifting through them in a seemingly chaotic manner.
artifacts.descZh: 这个以巨龙鳞片制成的护甲闪耀着五颜六色的光芒，它们在鳞甲表面不断的变化着。

artifacts.name: Cinderfeet
artifacts.desc: A cautionary tale tells of the ancient warlock by the name of Caim, who fancied himself daily walks through Goedalath, both to test himself and the harsh demonic wastes. He was careful to never bring anything back with him, lest it provide a beacon for the demons to find him. Unfortunately, over time, his sandals drenched in the soot and ashes of the fearscape and the fire followed his footsteps outside, drawing in the conclusion of his grim fate.
artifacts.descZh: 这是一个警示故事，讲的是有个叫凯姆的古代术士，为了勘查地狱般的恶魔荒原，也为了考验自己，自命不凡的认为可以在恶魔的老巢高达勒斯天天散步。他每次从恶魔位面归来都小心翼翼地不敢带回任何东西，生怕成为恶魔找到他的指引。不幸的是，来回很多次以后，他的草鞋浸满了恐惧之地的烟尘和灰烬。地狱之焰随他的脚步被带到了世间，同时也注定了他悲惨的命运。

specialDesc.en: Each step you take leaves a burning trail behind you lasting 5 turns that deals %d fire damage (based on Spellpower) to foes who enter it.
specialDesc.zh: 你每踏出一步会在脚下留下一条持续5回合的燃烧痕迹，对所有经过的生物造成 %d 火焰伤害 (基于法术强度)

artifacts.name: Cloak of Daggers
artifacts.desc: This cloak seems to incorporate a series of blades attached to various spring mechanisms.  Apparently the designer believed that the best defense was an active one.
artifacts.descZh: 这件披风上布满了刀刃和机关。显然制作者认为'最好的防御就是进攻'。

specialDesc.en: Has a 50%% chance each turn to slash an adjacent enemy for %d physical damage (based on Cunning), making them bleed.
specialDesc.zh: 每回合有50%%几率打击邻近的敌人，造成%d物理伤害（基于灵巧），并造成目标流血。

artifacts.name: Cloth of Dreams
artifacts.desc: Touching this cloak of otherworldly fabric makes you feel both drowsy yet completely aware.
artifacts.descZh: 当你触摸这件超脱尘俗的披风时你既觉得昏昏欲睡又十分清醒。

artifacts.name: Cloud Caller
artifacts.desc: This hat's broad brim protects you from biting colds and sudden storms.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶帽子宽阔的帽檐保护您免受呼啸的寒风和突如其来的暴风雨.

specialDesc.en: A small storm cloud follows you, dealing 15 lightning damage to all enemies in a radius of 3 each turn.
specialDesc.zh: 一团小小的风暴包围着你，每回合对周围3码内的敌人造成15闪电伤害。

artifacts.name: Colaryem
artifacts.desc: This intricate blade is impractically long and almost as wide as your body, yet contrary to its size and apparent girth it is not only light, but threatens to escape your grasp and fly away. You will need to be really strong to keep it grounded. Or really big.
artifacts.descZh: 这把长得不可思议的剑几乎和人一样宽，与其巨大尺寸格格不入的是，它的重量极轻，而且似乎总想要从你的手中飞走一样。要么足够强壮，要么足够高大，你才能握紧这剑，防止其飞走。

specialDesc.en: Attack speed improves with your strength and size category.
specialDesc.zh: 攻击速度随力量和体型变化。

artifacts.name: Coral Spray
artifacts.desc: A chunk of jagged coral, dredged from the ocean.
artifacts.descZh: 用大块的珊瑚制成，源自大海深处。

artifacts.name: Core of the Forge
artifacts.desc: This blazing hot mindstar beats rhythmically, releasing a burst of heat with each strike.
artifacts.descZh: 这块灼热发光的灵晶有节奏地律动着，每次攻击会放出一波热量。

artifacts.name: Corpathus
artifacts.desc: Thick straps encircle this blade. Jagged edges like teeth travel down the blade, bisecting it. It fights to overcome the straps, but lacks the strength.
artifacts.descZh: 这把剑被厚重的带所束缚。两排锯齿状的锋刃沿着剑身直到剑柄，它试图挣脱带子的束缚，但似乎缺乏足够的力量。

items.value: grows dramatically in power
grows in power

artifacts.name: Corpsebow
artifacts.desc: A lost artifact of the Age of Dusk, the Corpsebow is filled with a lingering essence of that era's terrible plagues. Those struck by arrows fired from its rotten string find themselves afflicted by echoes of ancient sickness.
artifacts.descZh: 一件黄昏纪遗失的武器，腐尸之弓浑身缠绕着那个时代的瘟疫精华。被腐朽弓弦射出的箭所击中的人，会因古老疾病在体内的共鸣而倍受折磨。

artifacts.name: Corrupted Gaze
artifacts.desc: This helmet radiates a dark power. Its visor seems to twist and corrupt the vision of its wearer. You feel worried that if you were to lower it for long, the visions may affect your mind.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶头盔散发着黑暗的力量。它似乎能够扭曲和腐化装备者的视觉。你不能穿戴它太长时间，以免堕入魔道。

artifacts.name: Crimson Robe
artifacts.desc: This robe was formerly owned by Callister the Psion, a powerful Psionic that pioneered many Psionic abilities. After his wife was murdered, Callister became obsessed with finding her killer, using his own hatred as a fuel for new and disturbing arts. After forcing the killer to torture himself to death, Callister walked the land, forcing any he found to kill themselves - his way of releasing them from the world's horrors. One day, he simply disappeared. This robe, soaked in blood, was the only thing he left behind.
artifacts.descZh: 这件长袍曾被卡利斯特拥有，他是一名强大的灵能力者，拥有各种能力。在他的妻子被谋杀之后，卡利斯特执着于寻找凶手,用自己的仇恨作为燃料，创造了令人不安的技术。让杀手折磨自己致死后,他行走在地上,迫使任何他发现的人自杀——这是他从世界的恐怖中给予人解脱的方式。有一天,他消失了。这浸泡在血液中的长袍,是他留下的唯一物品。

specialDesc.en: Increases your solipsism threshold by 20% (if you have one). If you do, also grants 15% global speed when worn.
specialDesc.zh: 增加唯我临界点20%，之后增加15%整体速度

artifacts.name: Crooked Club
artifacts.desc: An oddly twisted club with a hefty weight on the end. There's something very strange about it.
artifacts.descZh: 诡异扭曲的棒槌，尾部异常沉重。

items.value: Reduce targets accuracy and powers by 5 (stacks 5 times)

artifacts.name: Crown of Command
artifacts.desc: This crown was worn by the Halfling king Roupar, who ruled over the Nargol lands in the Age of Dusk.  Those were dark times, and the king enforced order and discipline under the harshest of terms.  Any who deviated were punished, any who disagreed were repressed, and many disappeared without a trace into his numerous prisons.  All must be loyal to the crown or suffer dearly.  When he died without heir the crown was lost and his kingdom fell into chaos.
artifacts.descZh: 半身人国王洛帕曾佩戴这顶王冠，他曾于黄昏纪统治着纳格尔大陆。那是黑暗的年代，国王通过最残暴的手段执行他的命令和法律。任何违背他思想的人都被严厉的惩罚，任何反对他的人都被无情的镇压，这些人大部分都无声无息的消失了——被关进了国王那不计其数的监狱里。所有人都必须表示忠诚或者付出昂贵的代价。他在没有子嗣的情况下死去，皇冠失踪的同时他的国家也陷入了混乱。

artifacts.name: Crown of Eternal Night
artifacts.desc: This crown looks useless, yet you can feel it is woven with fell magics of undeath. Maybe it has a use.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶王冠看起来毫无用处，尽管如此你仍能感受到它是由亡灵能量编织而成的。可能会有些用处吧。

artifacts.name: Crown of the Elements
artifacts.desc: This jeweled crown shimmers with colors.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶镶嵌宝石的王冠闪闪发光。

artifacts.name: Crude Iron Battle Axe of Kroll
artifacts.desc: Made in times before the Dwarves learned beautiful craftsmanship, the rough appearance of this axe belies its great power. Only Dwarves may harness its true strength, however.
artifacts.descZh: 打造于矮人学会精巧工艺之前，外表的粗糙掩盖了这把斧头的强大威力。不过也只有矮人才能让它发挥出真正的力量。

artifacts.name: Crystal Focus
artifacts.desc: This crystal radiates the power of the Spellblaze itself.
artifacts.descZh: 这个水晶散发着魔力的光辉。

usePower.name: combine with a weapon (makes a non enchanted weapon into an artifact)
usePower.nameZh: 安装至一把武器（可以将未附魔的武器变成一件神器）

specialDesc.en: (The created item can be activated to recover the Focus.)
specialDesc.zh: （被创建的物品可以被激活，以重新取回魔力结晶）

artifacts.name: Crystal Heart
artifacts.desc: This crystal is huge, easily the size of your head. It sparkles brilliantly almost of its own accord.
artifacts.descZh: 这颗水晶很大，几乎和你的头一样大。它闪烁着动人的光辉。

usePower.name: combine with a suit of body armor (makes a non enchanted armour into an artifact)
usePower.nameZh: 安装至一件护甲（可以将未附魔的武器变成一件神器）

specialDesc.en: (The created item can be activated to recover the Heart.)
specialDesc.zh: （被制造的物品可以被激活，以重新取回水晶之心）

artifacts.name: Crystal Shard
artifacts.desc: This crystalline tree branch is remarkably rigid, and refracts light in myriad colors. Gazing at it entrances you, and you worry where its power may have come from.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄法杖像水晶般透明，尺寸精确无比，从不同角度看去，反射出种种光芒。凝视着它，你会好奇：它的魔力究竟来自哪里。

usePower.name: create 2 living shards of crystal to serve you for 10 turns
usePower.nameZh: 制造两片活的水晶体来为你服务10回合。

artifacts.name: Crystle's Astral Bindings
artifacts.desc: Said to have belonged to a lost Anorithil, stars are reflected in the myriad surfaces of these otherworldly bindings.
artifacts.descZh: 相传这副手套曾属于一位不知名的星月法师。无数的星辰从这副手套的表面反射出来，显得超凡脱俗。

artifacts.name: Cuirass of the Dark Lord
artifacts.desc: Worn by a villain long forgotten, this armor was powered by the blood of thousands of innocents. Decrepit and old, the dark lord died in solitude, his dominion crumbled, his subjects gone. Only this cuirass remained, dying to finally taste fresh blood again.
artifacts.descZh: 这件胸甲属于一个早已被人遗忘的暴君，成千上万无辜死者的鲜血强化了这件铠甲。黑暗领主最终在衰老与虚弱中孤独的死去，他的统治分崩离析，他的人民四散而去。只有这件胸甲被保留了下来，渴望着再次品尝鲜血的味道。

usePower.name: drain blood from all creatures within range 5, causing them to bleed for %0.2f physical damage over 4 turns (based on your Physicalpower). For each creature drained (up to 10), the armor gains strength, which fades over 10 turns if it is not fed
usePower.nameZh: 吸收半径5内所有生物的血液，令其在 4 回合内受到 %0.2f 点物理伤害。每吸收一个生物（至多10），护甲的属性增加。 10回合后复原。

specialDesc.en: Blood Charges: %d
specialDesc.zh: 鲜血吸收：%d

artifacts.name: Cuirass of the Thronesmen
artifacts.desc: This heavy dwarven-steel armour was created in the deepest forges of the Iron Throne. While it grants incomparable protection, it demands that you rely only on your own strength.
artifacts.descZh: 这件沉重的矮人钢护甲打造于钢铁王座最深的熔炉。虽然它被赋予了举世无双的防护能力，但你必须得靠自己的力量使用它。

artifacts.name: Cut Drem Arm
artifacts.nameZh: 被切下来的德瑞姆手臂
artifacts.desc: The arm appears desiccated, but you swear that you see something wriggling underneath its ashen skin.
artifacts.descZh: 这条手臂看上去已经风干了，但你可以发誓，你看到有什么东西在它的皮肤下蠕动。

specialDesc.en: The arm can sometimes reach out to a foe in radius 5 and grab it to you with a tentacle pull. This action is not your own choice, it has a mind of its own.
specialDesc.zh: 这条手臂有时可以伸向半径5范围内的一个敌人，用触手把他拉到你的身边。这个行为并不出自于你的选择，而是出于它自己的意志。

artifacts.name: Dagger of the Past
artifacts.desc: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the opportunity to learn from the mistakes of the past.
artifacts.descZh: 传说这把匕首是一对兵器中的一个；这对兵器打造于时空守卫最初的年代。对于未经训练的持有者来说它还不是那么完善；对于时空守卫来说，它表示着从以前的失误中吸取教训的机会。

artifacts.name: Dakhtun's Gauntlets
artifacts.desc: Fashioned by Grand Smith Dakhtun in the Age of Allure, these dwarven-steel gauntlets have been etched with golden arcane runes and are said to grant the wearer unparalleled physical and magical might.
artifacts.descZh: 厄流纪由大师级铁匠打造而成。那些矮人钢臂铠镂刻着晦涩难懂的金色符文，据说它们可以赋予穿戴者强大的魔武力量。

artifacts.name: Daneth's Neckguard
artifacts.desc: A thick steel gorget designed to protect its wearer from fatal attacks to the neck.  This particular gorget was worn by the Halfling General Daneth Tendermourn during the pyre wars, and judging by the marks along its surface may have saved the General's life on more than one occasion.
artifacts.descZh: 一个厚重的钢护喉，旨在保护其穿着者颈部免受致命攻击。这个特殊的护喉是半身人将军丹纳斯·坦德莫恩在派尔纪战争中佩戴过的，上面的各种伤痕表明其可能救过这位将军不止一次。

artifacts.name: Dawn's Blade
artifacts.desc: Said to have been forged in the earliest days of the Sunwall, this longsword shines with the light of daybreak, capable of banishing all shadows.
artifacts.descZh: 传说是在太阳堡垒成立之初打造，这把长剑闪耀着黎明破晓之光，可以破除一切黑暗。

usePower.name: invoke dawn, inflicting %0.2f light damage in radius %d (based on Magic) and lighting the area within radius %d
usePower.nameZh: 激发黎明的光芒，在半径%d内造成%0.2f光系伤害（基于魔法），并照明%d码。

artifacts.name: Death's Embrace
artifacts.desc: This deep black leather armor, wrapped with thick silk, is icy cold to the touch.
artifacts.descZh: 这件黑色的皮甲上覆盖着一层厚厚的丝绸，触感冰凉。

usePower.name: turn yourself invisible (power %d, based on Cunning and Magic) for 10 turns
usePower.nameZh: 隐形10回合(强度%d, 基于灵巧和魔法）

artifacts.name: Decayed Visage
artifacts.desc: A desiccated mask of human skin, all that remains of a necromancer from the Age of Pyre who failed to achieve lichdom.  The transformative process partially succeeded, leaving him unable to die as his body slowly rotted from the inside out over several years.  Now his spirit resides within this last bit of mummified flesh, still hungering for eternal life.
artifacts.descZh: 一小片人皮面具，是派尔纪一位死灵法师的遗物。他试图变成巫妖，但是没有成功。他的身体逐渐腐烂，但由于未成功的法术而不能死去，就这样过了数年。现在，他的灵魂仍藏身于这小块皮肤中，渴求着永恒的生命。

artifacts.name: Dedication
artifacts.desc:
It is said that the preferred weapons of the krog is a mace in one hand and a sword in the other. One hand to spread the message of the Zigurath, the other to see that message through to the end.
The mace symbolizes the krogs willingness to endure until the final blow is struck against the arcane. Commonly the mace would be used to batter a mage senseless, thus preventing them from being able to cast their spells.
artifacts.descZh:
人们说克罗格首选的武器是一手拿剑一手拿锤。用一只手传播伊格兰斯的讯息，而用另一只手来让自己能够坚持到把这一信息传达到最后。
锤象征着克罗格愿意抵抗奥术力量的侵袭直到最后。这把锤子用来击打那些法师，可以让那些法师失去施展魔法的能力。

artifacts.name: Deflector
artifacts.desc: The front plate of this shield vibrates at all times, covering some strange assembly you can't quite make sense of.
artifacts.descZh: 盾牌的正面不停地颤动，似乎有着某种你不理解的节奏。

specialDesc.en: Knocks melee attackers away. Distance scales with damage incoming.
specialDesc.zh: 击退近战攻击者。距离和其造成的伤害有关。

artifacts.name: Destala's Scales
artifacts.desc: This cloak is made from the scales of an infamous Venom Drake that terrorized the country side towards the end of the Age of Dusk. It was slain by a party led by Kestin Highfin, who had this cloak fashioned personally.
artifacts.descZh: 黄昏纪末年，一条不知名的毒龙威胁着乡村，冒险家科斯汀·赫菲因率领的小队杀死了这条恶龙，用它的鳞片制作了这件时尚的斗篷。

artifacts.name: Dethblyd
artifacts.desc: Grushgore the Destroyer was as famous for his incredible brutality as he was for his childlike intelligence. He wasn't known for his subtlety of naming, but there's no denying the power of his massive sword.
artifacts.descZh: 毁灭者格鲁什戈尔以头脑简单四肢发达闻名。他从不擅长谋略，但他的力量无以伦比。

items.value: Increases all damage dealt, and reduces all damage taken, by 1%, stacking up to 10 times. Resets after 10 turns without attacking.

artifacts.name: Dethzaw
artifacts.desc:
Grushgore the Destroyer was absolutely enthralled when he discovered steamsaws. He immediately kidnapped several tinkerers and forced them to create this for him.
His naming skills have not improved.
artifacts.descZh:
毁灭者格鲁什戈尔发现蒸汽链锯时十分激动，他立刻抓了几个工程师，强迫他们为他做了这个。
他的取名技巧从没有得到提高。

items.value: deal a melee attack against all other enemies in a circle around you

artifacts.name: Dragon-helm of Kroltar
artifacts.desc: A visored steel helm, embossed and embellished with gold, that bears as its crest the head of Kroltar, the greatest of the fire drakes.
artifacts.descZh: 一个装饰着黄金浮雕的钢铁全盔。库洛塔的头盔上昂立着最伟大的喷火龙作为装饰。

artifacts.name: Dragonskull Helm
artifacts.desc: Traces of a dragon's power still remain in this bleached and cracked skull.
artifacts.descZh: 在这个灰白而残破的头骨中还残留着巨龙的能量。

artifacts.name: Drake's Bane
artifacts.desc: The killing of Kroltar, mightiest of wyrms, took seven months and the lives of 20,000 dwarven warriors.  Finally the beast was worn down and mastersmith Gruxim, standing atop the bodies of his fallen comrades, was able slit its throat with this axe crafted purely for the purpose of penetrating the wyrm's hide.
artifacts.descZh: 库洛塔的噩梦，最强大的龙，7个月的时间她带走了20，000矮人战士的生命。这条猛兽的力气最终被耗尽了，工匠大师格鲁克西姆，站在同伴们尸体的顶端，他用这把精工打造的斧头斩开了龙的鳞甲，剖开了龙的喉咙。

artifacts.name: Dream Malleus
artifacts.desc: A large shimmering maul that seems to produce a ringing in your ears.  It is both as malleable as thought and as hard as the strongest steel.
artifacts.descZh: 一个闪闪发光的大木槌,你的耳朵里似乎能听到它发出的声音.它既像思想一样有可塑性也像最强的钢铁那样坚硬.

artifacts.name: Dreamweaver
artifacts.desc: This isn't so much a gun, as it is the idea of a gun.  You'll be able to remember it pretty easily if you lose it.
artifacts.descZh: 这并不能算是一把枪，因为它只是一把枪的概念。当你丢掉它时你就记住它了。

usePower.name: throw the gun and cause it to explode, dealing by %d mind damage (based on Cunning and Willpower) to all targets in an area, attempting to put them to sleep, and disarming yourself for 3 turns
usePower.nameZh: 将枪扔出去引发爆炸，对范围内的所有敌人造成%d精神伤害（基于灵巧和意志），并试图催眠它们。你自己会被缴械3回合

artifacts.name: Dúathedlen Heart
artifacts.desc: This dark red heart still beats despite being separated from its owner.  It also snuffs out any light source that comes near it.
artifacts.descZh: 这颗暗红色的心脏虽然离开了它的主人，但仍在跳动着。它还会熄灭任何靠近它的光源。

specialDesc.en: The heart seems to absorb light when you deal darkness damage. Standing on unlit tiles, you feel stronger.
specialDesc.zh: 这颗心脏在你造成黑暗伤害的时候会吸收光亮。站在未照亮的方格上，你会变得更强。

artifacts.name: Earthen Beads
artifacts.desc: This is a string of ancient, hardened clay beads, cracked and faded with age. It was used by Wilders in ancient times, in an attempt to enhance their connection with Nature.
artifacts.descZh: 这是一串古朴而坚硬的陶制串珠，年代久远，已经破碎褪色。它制作于黄昏纪，用来增加和自然的联系。

specialDesc.en: Enhances the effectiveness of Meditation by 20%
specialDesc.zh: 强化冥想效果20%

artifacts.name: Eastern Wood Hat
artifacts.desc: This hat was made from materials from a forest whose name is long since lost, far in the east. It is said to have belonged to one of the first gunslingers.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶皮帽的材料来自于遥远的树林，人们早已遗忘了树林的名字。据说它的主人曾是最早的枪手之一。

artifacts.name: Eclipse
artifacts.desc: This tall staff is tipped with a pitch black sphere that yet seems to give off a strong light.
artifacts.descZh: 这根法杖前部镶嵌有黑色的倾斜球体，似乎正发出强光。

artifacts.name: Eden's Guile
artifacts.desc: The boots of a Rogue outcast, who knew that the best way to deal with a problem was to run from it.
artifacts.descZh: 这双靴子属于一位流浪的盗贼，他处理麻烦的方法就是三十六计走为上计。

usePower.name: boost speed by %d%% (based on Cunning)
usePower.nameZh: 增加 %d%% 速度(基于灵巧)

artifacts.name: Eel-skin armour
artifacts.desc: This armour seems to have been patched together from many eels. Yuck.
artifacts.descZh: 这个护甲似乎是由很多电鳗碎片拼接起来的。真恶心。

artifacts.name: Eksatin's Ultimatum
artifacts.desc: This gore-stained battleaxe was once used by an infamously sadistic king, who took the time to personally perform each and every execution he ordered. He kept a vault of every head he ever removed, each and every one of them carefully preserved. When he was overthrown, his own head was added as the centrepiece of the vault, which was maintained as a testament to his cruelty.
artifacts.descZh: 这把被血液浸满的双手斧曾被一位不知名的虐待成性的国王使用，他用这把斧头亲自执行了不少死刑。国王有一个房间专门用来收藏他杀死的人的头骨，每一个都完好的保存者。当国王被推翻时，他自己的头颅也进入了这间房子，作为他暴行的证据而保存。

items.value: decapitate a weakened target

artifacts.name: Eldoral Last Resort
artifacts.desc: A sling with an inscription on its handle: 'May the wielder be granted cunning in his fight against the darkness'.
artifacts.descZh: 投石器的把手上有一段铭文：“愿持有者于对抗黑暗之时被赐予神一般的机智。”

specialDesc.en: When dropping below 30% max HP, you gain 20% attack speed, lose 100% fatigue, and your shots don't consume ammo for 5 turns. 30 turns cd.
specialDesc.zh: 当你的生命降低到最大生命值30%的时候，在5回合内，你获得20%攻击速度，降低100%疲劳，且射击不消耗弹药。冷却时间30回合。

artifacts.name: Eldritch Pearl
artifacts.desc: Thousands of years spent inside the temple of creation have infused this pearl with the fury of rushing water. It pulses light.
artifacts.descZh: 造物主神庙千年的时间里，这颗珍珠它被注入了波涛的愤怒。它向外辐射着光芒。

artifacts.name: Elemental Fury
artifacts.desc: This ring shines with many colors.
artifacts.descZh: 这枚戒指闪耀着多种不同的色彩。

specialDesc.en: All your damage is converted and split into arcane, fire, cold and lightning.
specialDesc.zh: 你造成的所有伤害被转化均分为奥术、火焰、寒冷和闪电伤害。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Avoidance
artifacts.desc: A vial of opaque green fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶浑浊的绿色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Brawn
artifacts.desc: A vial of sluggish tan fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶粘稠的棕褐色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Explosive Force
artifacts.desc: A vial of churning orange fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶浑浊的橙色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Focus
artifacts.desc: A vial of clear, steaming fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶透明的沸腾液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Foundations
artifacts.desc: A vial of murky white fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶朦胧的白色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Invulnerability
artifacts.desc: A vial of thick fluid, metallic and reflective. It's incredibly heavy.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶粘稠的反射着金属光泽的液体。它有着难以置信的重量。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Mastery
artifacts.desc: A vial of thick maroon fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶浓郁的栗色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Mysticism
artifacts.desc: A vial of glowing cyan fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶炽热的青色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Precision
artifacts.desc: A vial of chunky red fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶粘稠的红色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Serendipity
artifacts.desc: A vial of lively yellow fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶流动的黄色液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of Stoneskin
artifacts.desc: A vial of grainy, iron-colored fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶带有特殊纹理、泛着金属光泽的液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of the Fox
artifacts.desc: A vial of pink, airy fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶粉红色的透明液体。

artifacts.name: Elixir of the Savior
artifacts.desc: A vial of bubbling, slate-colored fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 一瓶翻滚着泡沫的灰色液体。

artifacts.name: Emblem of Evasion
artifacts.desc: Said to have belonged to a master of avoiding attacks, this gilded steel emblem symbolizes his talent.
artifacts.descZh: 据说它曾属于一位闪避大师，这根镀金的腰带部分的保存了他的能力。

artifacts.name: Epoch's Curve
artifacts.desc:
Epoch's Curve has served the Wardens for generations and was passed from Warden to Warden for many years before being lost.
According to legend it was made from the first ash sapling to sprout after the Spellblaze and carries powers of both time and renewal.
artifacts.descZh:
在亚伯契的弧线失踪前，它已经服务于守卫们数载，代代相传。
根据历史记载，它是用魔法大爆炸后第一棵长出的白蜡树制成，拥有时空和恢复的力量。

artifacts.name: Eternity's Counter
artifacts.desc: This hourglass of otherworldly crystal appears to be filled with countless tiny gemstones in place of sand. As they fall, you feel the flow of time change around you.
artifacts.descZh: 这只漂亮的沙漏里装载着数以千计的宝石，用以代替沙子。当它们落下时，你能够感受到时间的变化。

usePower.name: flip the hourglass (sands currently flowing towards %s)
usePower.nameZh: 翻转沙漏(沙子目前流向%s)

specialDesc.en: Offers either offensive or defensive benefits, depending on the position of the sands.  Switching the direction of flow takes no time.
specialDesc.zh: 根据沙的位置在进攻增益和防守增益间切换。切换沙的流向不消耗时间。

artifacts.name: Ethereal Embrace
artifacts.desc: This cloak waves and bends with shimmering light, reflecting the depths of space and the heart of the Aether.
artifacts.descZh: 这件斗篷漂浮弯曲，发出闪耀的光芒，折射出空间深处、以太核心。

specialDesc.en: Damage shields have +1 duration and +15% power
specialDesc.zh: 伤害护盾增加一回合持续时间和15%强度

artifacts.name: Evermoss Robe
artifacts.desc: This thick robe is woven from a dark green moss, firmly bound and cool to the touch. It is said to have rejuvenating properties.
artifacts.descZh: 这件厚厚的长袍使用一大块深绿的苔藓织成的，十分牢固，摸上去很清凉。据说，它能让人恢复青春。

artifacts.name: Everpyre Blade
artifacts.desc: This ornate blade is carved from the wood of a tree said to burn eternally. Its hilt is encrusted with gems, suggesting it once belonged to a figure of considerable status. The flames seem to bend to the will of the sword's holder.
artifacts.descZh: 从永不停止燃烧的树上截取下来的木头，精心雕刻后形成的华丽的剑。剑柄用宝石做外壳，暗示其奇特的状态。剑身的火焰似乎能按照剑主人的意愿扭曲。

artifacts.name: Exiler
artifacts.desc:
The chronomancer known as Solith was renowned across all of Eyal. He always seemed to catch his enemies alone.
In the case of opponents who weren't alone, he had to improvise.
artifacts.descZh: 时空法师索利斯在马基埃亚尔的世界中十分有名。他总是抓住了他的敌人落单之时。即使对手不是独自一人,他也能临场发挥。

usePower.name: attempt to inflict %0.2f temporal damage (based on Spellpower and Paradox, if any) on foes in a radius %d ball out to range %d (chance depends on rank, summons are always affected), removing any that survive from time for up to %d turn(s)
usePower.nameZh: 对半径%d内所有目标目标造成 %0.2f 时空伤害（基于魔法和紊乱），射程%d。如果仍存活则移出时间线%d回合。

artifacts.name: Eyal's Will
artifacts.desc: This smooth green crystal flows with a light green slime in its core. Droplets occasionally form on its surface, tufts of grass growing quickly on the ground where they fall.
artifacts.descZh: 光滑的绿色晶体，内部有闪亮的绿色液体在流动。偶尔一小滴液体渗了出来，滴在地上，地面马上就长满了青草。

artifacts.name: Eye of Summer
artifacts.desc: This mindstar glows with a bright warm light, but seems somehow incomplete.
artifacts.descZh: 这个灵晶散发着温暖的微光,但似乎有点残缺.

artifacts.name: Eye of the Dreaming One
artifacts.desc: This ethereal eye stares eternally, as if seeing things that do not truly exist.
artifacts.descZh: 这个眼睛永远是睁着的，似乎并不相信它见到的事物。

artifacts.name: Eye of the Forest
artifacts.desc: This leather cap is overgrown with a thick moss, except for around the very front, where an eye, carved of wood, rests. A thick green slime slowly pours from the corners of the eye, like tears.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶皮帽上长满了厚厚的苔藓，帽子正前方用木头刻上了一只眼睛——在眼睛中心，绿色的液体缓缓流动，仿佛眼泪一样。

artifacts.name: Eye of the Lost
artifacts.desc: A strange aura surrounds this mindstar. You feel a presence, but it is obscured, as if it refuses to be found.
artifacts.descZh: 灵晶周围有一层奇怪的领域。你能感觉到某个存在，但它被遮蔽了，就像它不愿意被察觉到一样。

usePower.name: see all other beings around you for 5 turns
usePower.nameZh: 看到你周围所有的生物5回合

items.value: reduces mental save

artifacts.name: Eye of the Wyrm
artifacts.desc: A black iris cuts through the core of this mindstar, which shifts with myriad colours. It darts around, as if searching for something.
artifacts.descZh: 灵晶的核心穿过一道彩虹，投射出七色的光芒，不断变换着颜色。

specialDesc.en: The breath attack has a chance to shift randomly between Fire, Ice, Lightning, Acid, and Sand each turn.
specialDesc.zh: 喷吐攻击的属性每回合有几率在火、冰、闪电、酸和沙之间随机切换。

artifacts.name: Eye of Winter
artifacts.desc: This mindstar glows with a dim cool light, but seems somehow incomplete.
artifacts.descZh: 这个灵晶散发着寒冷的微光,但似乎有点残缺.

artifacts.name: Fake Skullcleaver
artifacts.desc: A small but sharp axe, with a handle made of polished bone.  The blade has chopped through the skulls of many, and has been stained a deep crimson.
artifacts.descZh: 一把小巧而锋利的斧头，斧柄由打磨过的骨头制成。这把斧头打破了许多头骨，并被染成了鲜红色。

artifacts.name: Fanged Collar
artifacts.desc: This strange creature seems to melt around your neck, keeping its mouth open just wide enough so that its teeth do not touch you. You suspect that in the case your head somehow goes missing, the creature is going to make itself at home in your neck stump.
artifacts.descZh: 这个奇怪的生物围绕着你的脖子，把嘴大长到牙齿刚好不会碰到你的距离。你怀疑，如果你哪天掉了脑袋，这个生物就会把你的脖子当做它的家。

specialDesc.en: You have died, but that does not bother the collar at all...
specialDesc.zh: 你已经死了，不过看起来这个项环上的生物一点也不在乎…

artifacts.name: Fanged Collar
artifacts.desc: It's a head... but is it yours?
artifacts.descZh: 这是一个头…但是这是你的头吗？

artifacts.name: Fearfire Mantle
artifacts.desc: Black fires born of a blackened heart.
artifacts.descZh: 黑色的火焰从漆黑的心脏中涌出。

specialDesc.en: All enemies in radius 2 take 20 fire damage each turn and healing you for 10% of the damage dealt.
specialDesc.zh: 附近2码范围的敌人每回合受到20火焰伤害。你受到10%伤害值的治疗

artifacts.name: Feathersteel Amulet
artifacts.desc: The weight of the world seems a little lighter with this amulet around your neck.
artifacts.descZh: 当你带着这个项链，似乎整个世界都轻飘飘的。

artifacts.name: Fiery Choker
artifacts.desc: A choker made of pure flame, casting forever shifting patterns around the neck of its wearer. Its fire seems to not harm the wearer.
artifacts.descZh: 一个由火焰形成的护符，在它的佩戴者身上不断地改变着形状。它的火焰似乎不会伤害到佩戴者。

artifacts.name: Fire Dragon Shield
artifacts.desc: This large shield was made using scales of many fire drakes from the lost land of Tar'Eyal.
artifacts.descZh: 这个巨大的盾牌使用了很多生活在失落的大陆塔·埃亚尔的火龙的鳞片打造而成。

artifacts.name: Firewalker
artifacts.desc: This fiery robe was worn by the mad pyromancer Halchot, who terrorised many towns in the late Age of Dusk, burning and looting villages as they tried to recover from the Spellblaze.  Eventually he was tracked down by the Ziguranth, who cut out his tongue, chopped off his head, and rent his body to shreds.  The head was encased in a block of ice and paraded through the streets of nearby towns amidst the cheers of the locals.  Only this robe remains of the flames of Halchot.
artifacts.descZh: 这件炙热的长袍曾属于疯狂的烈焰术士哈克特，他在黄昏纪威胁过很多城镇，正当人们努力从战争中恢复元气的时候，他竟然对城镇烧杀抢掠。最终他被伊格兰斯捕获了。伊格兰斯割下他的舌头，砍掉他的脑袋，并把他的身体撕成小块。他的脑袋被封在一个大冰块里，并且在附近城镇的居民欢庆中进行了游街。只有这件长袍从哈克特的烈焰中保留了下来。

specialDesc.en: Damage all enemies in range 4 for 40 fire damage and yourself for 5 fire damage every turn.
specialDesc.zh: 每回合对周围4码范围内的敌人造成40火焰伤害，对你自己造成5火焰伤害。

artifacts.name: Fist of the Destroyer
artifacts.desc: These fell looking gloves glow with untold power.
artifacts.descZh: 这对手套看上去十分恐怖，闪耀着不明能量。

specialDesc.en:
Increases all damage by %d%% of current vim 
Current Bonus: %d%%
specialDesc.zh:
获得相当于你%d%%活力值的伤害加成
当前加成：%d%%

artifacts.name: Fists of the Desert Scorpion
artifacts.desc:
These wickedly spiked gauntlets belonged to an orc captain in the Age of Pyre who conquered the western sands, using them as a base to lay raids on Elvala to the south.  Known as The Scorpion, he seemed unconquerable in battle, able to pull enemies towards him with vicious mental force and lay down lethal blows on them.  Often a flurry of these yellow and black gauntlets would be the last thing great Shaloren mages would see before having the life crushed from them.

Finally The Scorpion was defeated by the alchemist Nessylia, who went to face the fiendish orc alone.  The captain pulled the elf towards him with a brutish cackle, but before he could batter the life from her flesh she tore off her robes, revealing eighty incendiary bombs strapped to her flesh.  With a spark from her fingers she triggered an explosion that could be seen for miles around.  To this day Nessylia is still remembered in song for the sacrifice of her immortal life to protect her people.
artifacts.descZh: 这只有着锋利尖刺的拳套属于一位派尔纪统治西部荒野的兽人领主，他依靠它们对埃尔瓦拉发动了数次袭击。他外号沙蝎，在战场上所向披靡，他可以用精神力量将敌人拉过来，也可以用拳套把箭矢挡下。通常永恒精灵法师们在死前看到的最后物品，便是这只黄黑相间的拳套残影。最终沙蝎在决斗中，被炼金术师奈瑟莉亚击败。当这副拳套的主人将精灵拉向他，还没来得及将她撕成两半时，精灵掀开了她的长袍——下面捆着的是八十多枚炼金炸弹。精灵指尖的火花，引发了数里外都能看到的大爆炸。直到今天，民间仍流传着奈瑟莉亚为保护她的子民而牺牲的诗歌。

artifacts.name: Flamewrought
artifacts.desc: These gloves seems to be made out of the exoskeletons of ritches. They are hot to the touch.
artifacts.descZh: 这副手套似乎是由里奇的甲壳组成。它们摸上去非常热。

artifacts.name: Flashpoint
artifacts.desc: "Have you ever looked at some guys and thought 'you know, I really wish they were on fire right now', but you didn't feel like walking all the way over there? Well, there's now a better way!"
artifacts.descZh: 你是否曾经看到一些人并且想：'你知道吗，我真的想要烧死这些人'，但是你又不想大费周章，现在有了一个更加方便的方法！

artifacts.name: Focus Whip
artifacts.desc: A small mindstar rests at top of this handle. As you touch it, a translucent cord appears, flicking with your will.
artifacts.descZh: 这只手柄上镶有一颗小小的灵晶。当你触摸它时，一根半透明的绳子浮现在你面前，并随着你的意志闪烁。

usePower.name: strike all targets in a line (for 100%% weapon damage as mind) out to range 4
usePower.nameZh:
打击一条长度为4码的直线上的所有目标，
造成相当于100%%武器伤害的精神伤害。

items.value: Try to fry your enemies brain (25% chance to brainlock)

artifacts.name: Forbidden Tome: "A View From The Gallery"
artifacts.desc: The story of Grung, a halfling separated from his tribe that is just trying to survive while a terrible war, very long ago, rages on.
artifacts.descZh: 这本书讲述着格朗格的故事，他是远古时代的一个半身人，从部落中走散。他只是想生存下去，然而一场毁天灭地的大战正在他的身边肆虐。

artifacts.name: Forbidden Tome: "Home, Horrific Home"
artifacts.desc: A tome of lost knowledge. Touching it you feel both sick and yet strangely at peace.
artifacts.descZh: 一本有关逝去的古老知识的书。触摸它让你同时感到不适和不知名的安心感。

artifacts.name: Forbidden Tome: "Of Knowledge And Horrors"
artifacts.desc: A gross tome of lost knowledge. Even touching it makes you feel sick.
artifacts.descZh: 一本有关逝去的古老知识的书。光是触摸它就足以让你感到不适。

artifacts.name: Forbidden Tome: "The Day It Came"
artifacts.desc: The cover of this tome is old and withered. As you hold it, you get the impression of many things. Despair, misery, desperation and hopelessness all assail you at once. Something about the book also promises great power, but at what cost?
artifacts.descZh: 这本书的封皮老而枯干。当你拿着它的时候，你感受到绝望、困难，痛苦，无助的感情向你袭来。书中的存在许诺着强大的力量，但是，代价是什么呢？

artifacts.name: Forbidden Tome: "The Illusory Castle"
artifacts.desc: The tome in front of you seems to be as much made of dreamstuff as it is from leather and parchment. Crystalline shards dance underneath its surface, giving you an impression of a world altering itself to the tune of some indiscernable logic.
artifacts.descZh: 在你面前的似乎是皮革和羊皮纸制成的梦幻般的东西。水晶般的碎片在它的表面起舞，让你觉得似乎世界在你的眼前以你无法察觉的逻辑发生着变化的感觉。

artifacts.name: Fortune's Eye
artifacts.desc:
This finely crafted telescope once belonged to the explorer and adventurer Kestin Highfin. With this tool in hand he traveled in search of treasures all across Maj'Eyal, and before his death it was said his collection was incredibly vast. He often credited this telescope with his luck, saying that as long as he had it, he could escape any situation, no matter how dangerous. It is said he died confronting a demon seeking revenge for a stolen sword.

His last known words were "Somehow this feels like an ending, yet I know there is so much more to find."
artifacts.descZh: 这副精致的望远镜曾属于一位著名的冒险家和探险家科斯汀·赫菲因。有此宝在手，赫菲因遍历了整个马基埃亚尔大陆，在他死前据说他搜集了许多宝贵的财富。他相信这副望远镜能带给他好运，有此物在手，无论面对任何险境，都能死里逃生。相传，他死于一名恶魔的报复，报复他偷走了恶魔私藏的一把剑。海风留给世间的最后遗言是——想要我的财富吗？那就去找吧，我的一切都在那里，大幕才刚刚拉开。

artifacts.name: Frost Lord's Chain
artifacts.desc: This impossibly cold chain of frost-coated metal radiates a strange and imposing aura.
artifacts.descZh: 这不可思议的金属链覆盖着极度寒霜，向外放射出诡异而强大的光环能量

specialDesc.en: Gives all your cold damage a 20% chance to freeze the target.
specialDesc.zh: 你造成寒冷伤害有20%几率冰冻目标。

artifacts.name: Frost Treads
artifacts.desc: A pair of leather boots. Cold to the touch, they radiate a cold blue light.
artifacts.descZh: 一双摸起来冰凉的皮靴，闪烁着冰冷的蓝色光芒。

specialDesc.en: Each step taken casts a ground frost effect in a radius of 1 around you for 5 turns, giving you a 20% cold damage bonus for 3 turns. Additionally, any enemy standing in the frost has a 20% chance of talent failure for 3 turns.
specialDesc.zh: 你走出的每一步都会在周围1码范围内产生冻结地面效果，持续5回合，使你获得20%寒冷伤害加成，持续3回合。此外，所有踩在冻结地面上的敌人在3回合内有20%几率技能使用失败。

artifacts.name: Frostbite
artifacts.desc: Fashioned from magical ice, and perfect for carving ice - especially ice with someone else inside it.
artifacts.descZh: 因为魔法的冰块而知名，非常适合雕刻冰块——尤其是里面有人的那些。

artifacts.name: Frozen Shards
artifacts.desc: In this dark blue pouch lie several small orbs of ice. A strange vapour surrounds them, and touching them chills you to the bone.
artifacts.descZh: 在这个深蓝色的袋子里，躺着许多冰晶弹。一团奇异的冰雾环绕着它们，当你触摸它们时，你感到刺骨的凉意。

items.value: bursts into an icy cloud

artifacts.name: Frozen Shroud
artifacts.desc: All that remains of the Glacial Legion. This cloak seems to exude an icy cold vapor that freezes all it touches.
artifacts.descZh: 格拉希尔·雷金的全部剩余。这件斗篷散发着的寒气冻结了周围的一切。

usePower.name: release a radius %d chilling blast, instantly dealing %0.2f cold damage and condensing the air into freezing vapors that deal %0.2f cold damage (based on Magic) each turn for %d turns
usePower.nameZh: 在半径 %d 范围内吹出冰风，立刻造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害，并将空气冻结成寒霜冰雾，每回合造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害（基于魔法），持续 %d 回合。

artifacts.name: Galen's Flowing Robe
artifacts.desc: This robe was worn by the Technomancer Galen, infused with technomancy enchantments it is said to react to techno-spells!
artifacts.descZh: 这身法袍是科技法师盖伦的创造，加入了科技法术的强化力量，可以对科技法术做出反应！

specialDesc.en:
20% chance when casting a technomancy spell (or 10% chance when casting a normal spell) to power-up the internal defense circuits of the robe.
The circuit will do one of:
#AQUAMARINE#if more than one foe is in melee range#LAST#: teleport away all foes
#AQUAMARINE#if below 50% life#LAST#: increase all resistances by 20% for 5 turns
#AQUAMARINE#if below 20 steam#LAST#: supercharge the arcane dynamo to produce 4 more steam per 10 mana spent for 5 turns
#AQUAMARINE#otherwise#LAST#: reset the cooldown of the spell with the highest remaining cooldown
specialDesc.zh:
当你释放科技法术的时候，你有20%几率（释放普通法术的时候几率为10%）激活长袍内部的防御电路。
防御电路会带来以下效果之一：
#AQUAMARINE#如果近战范围内有超过一个敌人#LAST#：将所有敌人传送走
#AQUAMARINE#如果生命值在50%以下#LAST#：提升所有抗性20%，持续5回合
#AQUAMARINE#如果蒸汽值低于20#LAST#：超载奥术发电机，每10点法力值额外产生4蒸汽，持续5回合
#AQUAMARINE#其他情况#LAST#：重置目前剩余冷却时间最长的法术的冷却时间

artifacts.name: Galen's Will
artifacts.desc: Saws made of metal? That is no good for a discerning Technomancer so Galen made a saw out of pure arcane forces!
artifacts.descZh: 金属制作的链锯？挑剔的科技法师可不会满足于此，所以盖伦用纯奥术力量制造了一把链锯！

specialDesc.en: Increases the steam your arcane dynamo generate per 10 points of mana by 2.
specialDesc.zh: 增加你的奥术发电机产生的蒸汽量，每消耗10点法力值产生的蒸汽量增加2。

artifacts.name: Gardanion, the Light of God
artifacts.desc:
"#{italic}#When Amakthel arrived, he created the Sun and brought life to this world.
You carry a piece of His Sun with you now. Do not forget who gave it to you, lest you become like those wretched fools who would forsake Him.#{normal}#"
artifacts.descZh:
"#{italic}#阿马克泰尔降临，他创造了太阳，为世界带来生命。
现在，你带着他的一片太阳。不要忘了是谁将它给予你，以免让你变成和那些抛弃他的可怜虫一样。#{normal}#"

specialDesc.en: When worn, gives you an additional prodigy point.
specialDesc.zh: 装备时，获得一点觉醒技能点。

artifacts.name: Garkul's Teeth
artifacts.desc: Hundreds of humanoid teeth have been strung together on multiple strands of thin leather, creating this tribal necklace.  One would have to assume that these are not the teeth of Garkul the Devourer but rather the teeth of Garkul's many meals.
artifacts.descZh: 数以百计的人类牙齿被串在用多股皮革结成的绳索上，组成了这个部落项链。那些牙齿并非吞噬者加库尔自己的，而是来自于加库尔的食物。

artifacts.name: Genocide
artifacts.desc: Farian was King Toknor's captain, and fought by his side in the great Battle of Last Hope.  However, when he returned after the battle to find his hometown burnt in an orcish pyre, a madness overtook him.  The desire for vengeance made him quit the army and strike out on his own, lightly armoured and carrying nought but his sword.  Most thought him dead until the reports came back of a fell figure tearing through the orcish encampments, slaughtering all before him and mercilessly butchering the corpses after.  It is said his blade drank the blood of 100 orcs each day until finally all of Maj'Eyal was cleared of their presence.  When the final orc was slain and no more were to be found, Farian at the last turned the blade on himself and stuck it through his chest.  Those nearby said his body shook with convulsions as he did so, though they could not tell whether he was laughing or crying.
artifacts.descZh: 法瑞安曾是图库纳国王的指挥官，在最后希望的伟大战役中跟随国王并肩作战。然而，当战争结束，凯旋归来之时，他却发现故乡处处燃烧着兽人的火焰，无边的怒火吞噬了他。复仇的欲望使他离开军队，孤身一人踏上了征程，他除了护甲之外只带了一柄剑。大多数人认为他已经死了。直到有消息称有一个毁灭者般的身影正在摧残兽人的营地，他屠杀了所有见到的兽人并残忍的肢解对方的尸体。据说他每天要用100个兽人的鲜血来祭刀直到杀光马基埃亚尔的兽人。当最后一个兽人被杀死并且没有发现更多的时候，法瑞安最终把利刃转向了自己——那把剑刺穿了他的胸膛。那些在附近的目击者说，当法瑞安这样做的时候身体伴随着阵阵痉挛，他们说不清他到底是哭是笑。

artifacts.name: Girdle of Preservation
artifacts.desc: A pristine belt of purest white leather with a runed voratun buckle. The ravages of neither time nor the elements have touched it.
artifacts.descZh: 一条有着沃瑞钽雕刻标志的皮带扣，用纯白色皮革制作的古朴的腰带。不论时间还是环境都不能对它造成任何损害。

artifacts.name: Girdle of the Calm Waters
artifacts.desc: A belt rumoured to have been worn by the Conclave healers.
artifacts.descZh: 传说这条腰带曾被孔克雷夫的治疗师们佩戴。

artifacts.name: Glacia
artifacts.desc: Strange coils encircle this extremely cold gun.
artifacts.descZh: 奇怪的线圈环绕着这把极其冰冷的枪。

items.value: deal cold damage equal to 100 + the higher of your steam or spellpower, and attempt to freeze the target (20% chance).

artifacts.name: Glory of the Pride
artifacts.desc: The most prized treasure of the Battlemaster of the Pride, Grushnak. This gold ring is inscribed in the now lost orc tongue.
artifacts.descZh: 这是普莱德的战争领主格鲁希纳克最宝贵的财富。这枚金戒指上铭刻着失传的兽人语。

artifacts.name: Gloves of the Firm Hand
artifacts.desc: These gloves make you feel rock steady! These magical gloves feel really soft to the touch from the inside. On the outside, magical stones create a rough surface that is constantly shifting. When you brace yourself, a magical ray of earth energy seems to automatically bind them to the ground, granting you increased stability.
artifacts.descZh: 这副手套让你觉得坚如磐石！这双充满魔力的手套从里面摸起来无比松软。在其外，魔法石创造了一个不断转动的粗糙表面。当你振作精神，一束包含大地能量的魔法射线会将它自动扎根在地面上，赋予你更高的稳定性。

artifacts.name: Glowing Core
artifacts.desc: This is all that's left of the Searing Horror. Even after its death, the object in your hand glows just as brightly as it did before.
artifacts.descZh: 这是灼热恐魔的残余部分。即使是在它死后，这个物体还是在你手中如同它活着的时候一样发出闪耀的光芒。

artifacts.name: Goedalath Rock
artifacts.desc: A small rock that seems from beyond this world, vibrating with a fierce energy.  It feels warped and terrible and evil... and yet oh so powerful.
artifacts.descZh: 这块小石头看起来不是这个世界的，它不时产生着激烈的能量震动，让人感到扭曲、可怕、邪恶……而又强大的能量。

artifacts.name: Golden Gun
artifacts.desc: A gun sure to turn all to ash. As long as its nearby.
artifacts.descZh: 一把可以摧毁任何事物的枪，以及周边的一切。

items.value: every third hit always crits.

artifacts.name: Golden Three-Edged Sword 'The Truth'
artifacts.desc: The wise ones say that truth is a three-edged sword. And sometimes, the truth hurts.
artifacts.descZh: 有些聪明人说真理是把三刃剑。因为有些时候，“真理”是会伤到人的。

items.value: 9% chance to stun or confuse the target

artifacts.name: Gravitational Staff
artifacts.desc: Time and Space seem to warp and bend around the massive tip of this stave.
artifacts.descZh: 法杖的尖端时空似乎陷入了扭曲。

artifacts.name: Great Caller
artifacts.desc: This mindstar constantly emits a low tone. Life seems to be pulled towards it.
artifacts.descZh: 这只灵晶不断的发出低鸣，你感觉到生命能量似乎在向它聚拢。

specialDesc.en: Gives a 30% chance that your nature summons appear as wild summons.
specialDesc.zh: 你的自然召唤有30%的几率升级为野性模式的召唤兽。

artifacts.name: Grinder
artifacts.desc: Originally a kitchen implement used by the giants to saw through tough, frozen carcasses. Something is especially sinister about this example though.
artifacts.descZh: 起初这个锯子只是被巨人们用来切割坚硬、冰冻的尸体。不过这个例子似乎有一些非常邪恶的暗示。

specialDesc.en: On Taking Damage: Blindside the attacker (range 6).
specialDesc.zh: 受伤触发: 闪电突袭 (范围 6).

artifacts.name: Guidance
artifacts.desc:
Said to have once belonged to Inquisitor Marcus Dunn during the Spellhunt this fist sized quartz crystal glows constantly with a soft white light and was rumoured to be a great aid in meditation, helping focus the mind, body, and soul of the owner as well as protecting them from the foulest of magics.
It seems somebody well versed in antimagic could use it to its fullest potential.
artifacts.descZh:
曾经属于魔法狩猎时期的检察官玛库斯·丹。这个拳头大小的石英晶体不断散发出柔和的白光。而且据说对冥想有相当大的帮助，不但可以帮助集中精神、身体，还可以保护持有者的灵魂，并且保护他们免遭邪恶魔法的侵蚀。
似乎只有拥有反魔力量的人才能发挥它的全部潜能。

artifacts.name: Guise of the Hated
artifacts.desc:
Forget the moons, the starry sky,
The warm and greeting sheen of sun,
The rays of light will never reach inside,
The heart which wishes that it be unseen.
artifacts.descZh:
月色皎洁，星空璀璨
阳光温暖，光辉耀闪
我心暗淡，其光难入
我心苦楚，莫可见述

artifacts.name: Gwai's Burninator
artifacts.desc: Gwai, a Pyromanceress that lived during the Spellhunt, was cornered by group of mage hunters. She fought to her last breath and is said to have killed at least ten people with this wand before she fell.
artifacts.descZh: 戈瓦，一个生活在魔法狩猎时的火焰术士，她被一群猎魔人逼入了绝境。她战斗至最后一刻，据说在她流尽最后一滴血之前她用这把魔杖干掉了至少十人。

usePower.name: shoot a cone of flames (radius %d) for %0.2f fire damage (based on Magic)
usePower.nameZh: 发射长度 %d 的锥形火焰，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害（基于魔法）。

artifacts.name: Hand of the World-Shaper
artifacts.desc: These heavy stone gauntlets make the very ground beneath you bend and warp as they move.
artifacts.descZh: 当这双沉重的手套移动时，大地会随之扭曲。

artifacts.name: Hands of Creation
artifacts.desc: From your hands have been wrought incredible works. Your works have been forged in fire, and so have you.
artifacts.descZh: 你的手中曾经创造出了无数惊人的作品，烈火中触摸无数作品的双手也被炽焰所围绕。

specialDesc.en: On landing any melee attack, release a fiery shockwave, dealing fire and physical damage each equal to your steampower in a cone from the target of radius 3.
specialDesc.zh: 近战攻击将释放冲击波，半径3的锥形范围内目标受到等于蒸汽强度的物理火焰伤害。

artifacts.name: Hare-Skin Sling
artifacts.desc:
This well-tended sling is made from the leather and sinews of a large hare. It feels smooth to the touch, yet very durable. Some say that the skin of a hare brings luck and fortune.
Hard to tell if that really helped its former owner, but it's clear that the skin is at least also strong and reliable.
artifacts.descZh:
这把投石索是由一只巨大的野兔皮精制而成。它摸起来光滑柔软却十分耐用。有人说，野兔皮可以带来幸运。
很难说它是否真的帮助了它的前任使用者，但是很显然这副毛皮既结实又可靠。

artifacts.name: Hat of Arcane Understanding
artifacts.desc:
A traditional pointed wizard's hat, made of fine purple elven-silk and decorated with bright silver runes. You sense it has been passed from ancient times, and has been born on the heads of great mages.
Touching the cloth you feel a sense of knowledge and power from bygone ages, yet it is partly sealed away, waiting for a trigger to release it.
artifacts.descZh: 一只传统巫师的尖帽子，由紫色的精灵丝绸制成，上面还有亮银色的装饰物。你意识到它来自远古时代，一个拥有众多伟大法师的时代。通过触摸你可以感受到远古的知识和能量，但仍有一部分被密封着，等待有缘人来释放它。

artifacts.name: Heartrend
artifacts.desc:
There is an attached note.
 
'I've spilt the heartsblood of my work, feeling it pound, like a heart, in my palms.
Some people just can't let go until they've bled dry.'
artifacts.descZh:
上面粘着一页笔记。
 
'我将我的心血之作分离，感受它的跳动，像心脏一样跳动，在我的手心里。
总有些人不到血流尽，不撒手。'

specialDesc.en:
All damage dealt by or to you (that is over 1% of max life) bleeds for an additional 20% of the damage as physical damage (ignores most status resistances).
While you are bleeding, Heartrend's damage increases and it gains lifesteal.
specialDesc.zh:
你受到与造成的所有超过1%总生命的伤害将触发流血效果，无视大部分状态免疫，造成额外20%物理伤害。
当你处于流血状态时，心脏切割伤害增加并具有吸血效果。

items.value: If bleed damage per turn is greater than 5% of max life, attacks cleave.

artifacts.name: Helm of Knowledge
artifacts.desc: A large crown, part metallic part glass that radiates with psionic powers.
artifacts.descZh: 一个大头盔，一半金属一半玻璃，放射出灵能力量。

usePower.name: sense the presence of unique objects
usePower.nameZh: 感知神器的存在。

specialDesc.en: It can be used without being worn.
specialDesc.zh: 不必装备也可以使用。

artifacts.name: Helm of the Dominated
artifacts.desc: An experimental helmet designed to enhance the effects of the Doomelf corruption.
artifacts.descZh: 这个头盔是为了提高魔化精灵的能力，而作为实验产品被制造出来。

specialDesc.en: Increases the range of Haste of the Doomed by 1.
specialDesc.zh: 增加种族技能“加速”的范围1码

artifacts.name: Helm of the Dwarven Emperors
artifacts.desc: A Dwarven helm embedded with a single diamond that can banish all underground shadows.
artifacts.descZh: 镶嵌着一颗钻石的矮人头盔，这颗宝石的光辉可以驱散地下一切阴影。

artifacts.name: Helmet of Accuracy (+6)
artifacts.desc: A finely-wrought helmet that increases your Accuracy by 6.
artifacts.descZh: 一只可以提高你6点命中的精工头盔。

artifacts.name: Honeywood Chalice
artifacts.desc: This wooden cup seems perpetually filled with a thick sap-like substance. Tasting it is exhilarating, and you feel intensely aware when you do so.
artifacts.descZh: 这个酒杯里装满了粘稠的物质，尝一口能提神醒脑。

artifacts.name: Hornet Stingers
artifacts.desc: A vile poison drips from the tips of these arrows.
artifacts.descZh: 箭矢的尖端滴落着剧毒。

items.value: afflicts the target with a poison dealing 20 damage per turn and causing actions to fail 20% of the time for 6 turns

artifacts.name: human myth of creation
artifacts.desc: Myth of creation of the humans.
artifacts.descZh: 人类的创世传说

artifacts.name: Hydra's Bite
artifacts.desc: This three-headed stralite flail strikes with the power of a hydra. With each attack it lashes out, hitting everyone around you.
artifacts.descZh: 这把三头的蓝锆石连枷，使用的是一只三头龙的力量。它的攻击可以伤害到周围的所有敌人。

items.value: hit up to two adjacent enemies

artifacts.name: Icy Kill
artifacts.desc:
As any scryer knows, the link between the murderer and the murdered is the murder weapon, and a scryer can follow that link from the murdered to the weapon to the murderer.
One rather cold blooded killer thought of a way around this. By carving blades out of ice, they could kill as they wished and the link would just melt away.
Their killing spree ended when one of the victims got lucky and managed to stab the murderer in the heart with the icey blade. After being united with the cold heart that created it, the final ice blade has never melted.
artifacts.descZh:
任何占卜师都知道，凶器乃是缉查凶手最重要的线索；他们往往顺着这条线索顺藤摸瓜，从人群中找出凶手的真身。
然而，一个冷酷的杀手找到了一个办法：他用寒冰铸成了一把利刃，将其刺入受害者的胸口，让其随着受害者心脏的体温渐渐融化，消失于无形。
最终，这名杀手仍然没有逍遥于法外。一名受害者幸运地夺下了利刃，反身刺入了杀手的心脏里。杀手冷酷的内心没有温度，而这把与其相融的利刃从此再也不会融化。

items.value: freezes the target
explodes a frozen creature (damage scales with willpower)

artifacts.name: Imp Claw
artifacts.desc: The battered remains of a flame imp's hand. It still burns with that unnatural flame.
artifacts.descZh: 这是一只火焰小鬼留下的满是伤痕的爪子。它还燃烧着不自然的火焰。

artifacts.name: Inertial Twine
artifacts.desc: This double-helical ring seems resistant to attempts to move it. Wearing it seems to extend this property to your entire body.
artifacts.descZh: 双螺旋状的戒指，很难将它移动，戴上它后似乎可以将其力量延展到整个身体。

artifacts.name: Infused Cerebrum
artifacts.desc: This #{italic}#headwear#{normal}# seems made entirely out of half-rotten brain matter. Do you really want to put that over your head?
artifacts.descZh: 这个 #{italic}# “帽子” #{normal}# 似乎是由已经半腐烂的大脑组成的。你真的还想把它呆在自己的头上吗？

usePower.name: assault the mind of a foe to utterly dominate it
usePower.nameZh: 打击目标的精神，彻底控制它

artifacts.name: Iron Mail of Bloodletting
artifacts.desc: Blood drips continuously from this fell suit of iron, and dark magics churn almost visibly around it. Bloody ruin comes to those who stand against its wearer.
artifacts.descZh: 鲜血不断的从这套骇人的铁甲上滴落，几乎可以看得见黑魔法在它的周围流动。胆敢阻挡装备者的人会遭到血腥的毁灭。

artifacts.name: Jaw of Rogroth
artifacts.desc: Rogroth's mouth happened to be about the same size as your waist. Interesting.
artifacts.descZh: 真有趣，罗格洛斯灵魂吞噬者的嘴巴正好和你的腰一样大。

usePower.name: deal darkness damage equal to your 350%% of your spellpower to a target, and, if it kills the target, restores 15% of max hp and all resources (except paradox and equilibrium)
usePower.nameZh: 对目标造成相当于你350%%法术强度的暗影伤害，如果这杀死了目标，恢复15%最大生命值和所有资源（紊乱值和失衡值除外）

artifacts.name: Jetpack
artifacts.desc: Finally.
artifacts.descZh: 终于。

artifacts.name: Khulmanar's Wrath
artifacts.desc: Blackened with soot and covered in spikes, this battleaxe roars with the flames of the Fearscape. Given by Urh'Rok himself to his general, this powerful weapon can burn even the most resilient of foes.
artifacts.descZh: 黑色的浓烟缠绕在这把双手斧上，恶魔空间的烈焰在其身上咆哮。这把战斧由乌鲁洛克授予他最强大的指挥官，它可以焚尽一切，包括最强大的敌人。

artifacts.name: Kinetic Focus
artifacts.desc: Kinetic energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
artifacts.descZh: 动能集中在这个灵晶的核心里.

artifacts.name: Kinetic Spike
artifacts.desc: A simple, rudely crafted stone hilt, this object manifests a blade of wavering, nearly invisible force, like a heat haze, as you grasp it. Despite its simple appearance, it is capable of shearing through solid granite, in the hands of those with the necessary mental fortitude to use it properly.
artifacts.descZh: 看似只是简单雕刻过的石柄，然而其前端显现着一道摇晃的刀锋。当你试图去抓住刀锋的时候，你感受到这是一股如热气般无形的力量。尽管外观粗糙，但它在意志足够坚强并且懂得使用它的人手里却可以削铁如泥。

usePower.name: fire a bolt of kinetic force (range %d), dealing 150%% (physical) weapon damage
usePower.nameZh: 发射灵能之力，在距离%d范围内造成150%%武器伤害。

artifacts.name: Kor's Fall
artifacts.desc: Made from the bones of many creatures, this staff glows with power. You can feel its evil presence even from a distance.
artifacts.descZh: 这根法杖由许多生物的骨头制成并散发着能量。你甚至可以在很远的地方感受到它的邪恶气息。

artifacts.name: Korbek's Spyglass
artifacts.desc: This antique spyglass is weathered from use, but seems well maintained.
artifacts.descZh: 这个年代久远的小型望远镜由于使用过多有些褪色，但是仍然保养得很好。

artifacts.name: Laser Powered Giant Smasher
artifacts.desc: The Laser Powered Giant Smasher, nicknamed the Gloryhammer. You can feel it vibrating with untold power in your hands.
artifacts.descZh: 激光驱动的巨型粉碎器，绰号“光锤”。你能感觉到它在你的手中以无穷的力量震动。

artifacts.name: Latafayn
artifacts.desc: This massive, flame-coated greatsword was stolen by the adventurer Kestin Highfin, during the Age of Dusk. It originally belonged to a demon named Frond'Ral the Red.  It roars with vile flames and its very existence seems to be a blight upon the lands.
artifacts.descZh: 这只沉重的、火焰覆盖的大剑，是黄昏纪中，英雄科斯汀·赫菲因偷来。这把剑曾经属于一个强大的恶魔，赤红之弗朗拉尔。它炽热的火焰怒吼着，仿佛可以焚烧万物。

usePower.name: accelerate burning effects on all creatures in a radius %d ball within range %d, consuming them to instantly inflict 125%% of all remaining burn damage
usePower.nameZh: 加速半径 %d 范围内的所有燃烧效果，范围 %d, 立刻造成 125%% 剩余燃烧伤害。

artifacts.name: Lecture on Humility by Archmage Linaniil
artifacts.nameZh: 大法师莱娜尼尔关于谦卑的演讲
artifacts.desc: Lecture on Humility by Archmage Linaniil. A tale of the first ages and the Spellblaze.
artifacts.descZh: 大法师莱娜尼尔关于谦卑的演讲。这是有关过去的时代和魔法大爆炸的传说。

artifacts.name: Legacy of the Naloren
artifacts.desc:
This incredibly beautiful -- and powerful -- trident is made of the rare metal orichalcum. An amazing pearl is seated in head of the trident, as it spreads into three razor sharp prongs.
It is imbued with the greatest strengths of all of the most powerful Naga warriors.
Slasul gave it to you as a sign of his faith in you. It is a sign of hope for all of the Naloren race, that one outside of their tribe could be so trusted.
artifacts.descZh:
这柄拥有着强大力量的三叉戟通体由奥利哈刚金属打造而成。一颗闪亮的珍珠镶嵌在其顶端，向前延伸而出的，是三道锋利的三叉戟刃。
它被灌输了娜迦即纳鲁精灵一族最强大战士的力量。
现在，萨拉苏尔将它赐予你，作为他对你的信任。同时，它也寄托了纳鲁一族的希望，只有你能受到他们如此的信任。

artifacts.name: Life Drinker
artifacts.desc: Black blood for foul deeds. This dagger serves evil.
artifacts.descZh: 愚者之血，邪魔之刃。

artifacts.name: Life Support Suit
artifacts.desc: "We've done it, men. We cured death."
artifacts.descZh: 我们做到了。我们能治疗死亡。

specialDesc.en:
You cannot bleed.
When you take damage, if your life is under 20%%, heal for 30%% of your max life. %s
specialDesc.zh:
你免疫流血伤害。
当你受到伤害的时候，如果你的生命值低于20%%，将会恢复30%%的最大生命值。%s

artifacts.name: Lifebinding Emerald
artifacts.desc: A lopsided, heavy emerald with murky green clouds shifting sluggishly under the surface.
artifacts.descZh: 一块不规则的厚重翡翠，表面有云纹浮动。

artifacts.name: Light of Revelation
artifacts.desc: The "lantern" appears to be a glowing shard of a glass-like substance. Despite how bright it is, its light deeply disturbs you. It illuminates everything in its wake, including things which you would rather not see. Part of you wants to throw it away, but another part wants to know the unearthly truths it will reveal to you.
artifacts.descZh: 这个“灯笼”似乎是一块发光的玻璃状物体的碎片。尽管它十分明亮，但它的光却让你深感不安。它照亮了身边的一切，包括你不愿意看到的东西。你内心的一部分想要把它扔掉，但另一部分却又渴望着它向你揭示的超自然的真相。

specialDesc.en: Sometimes reveals the hidden truths you'd rather not see.
specialDesc.zh: 有时会揭示你不应该知道的隐藏真相。

artifacts.name: Lightbringer's Wand
artifacts.desc: This gold-tipped wand shines with an unnatural sheen.
artifacts.descZh: 这个镶嵌着金子的魔棒散发出超自然的强光。

usePower.name: summon a stationary shining orb within range %d for 15 turns that will illuminate its area and deal %d light damage (based on your Magic and Strength) to your foes within radius %d each turn
usePower.nameZh: 召唤一个静止的光球，照亮%d的范围15回合，并每回合造成对%d码范围内的所有敌人造成%d光系伤害（基于魔法和力量）

artifacts.name: Lightning Catcher
artifacts.desc: A fine mesh of metal threads held together by a sturdy chain. Sparks dance across it.
artifacts.descZh: 一个坚固的铁链缠着细金属丝网。火花在上面跳舞.

specialDesc.en:
Taking lightning damage or making critical hits builds 2 energy charges, which give you +5% lightning damage and +1 to all stats.
The charges decay at a rate of 1 per turn. Max 10 charges.
specialDesc.zh:
每次接受雷电伤害或造成暴击雷电伤害时获得两点充能，每点充能提供 5%% 雷电伤害加成和 1 点全属性。
每回合损失一点加成。加成最多10层。

artifacts.name: Liquid Metal Cloak
artifacts.desc: This strange sheet of metal flows with the wind just like a normal cloak. Whoever crafted it was a true master.
artifacts.descZh: 这片奇特的金属如同普通的披风一样随风摆动。打造它的人无疑是一位大师。

artifacts.name: Lost Staff of Archmage Tarelion
artifacts.nameZh: 大法师泰尔兰丢失的法杖
artifacts.desc: Archmage Tarelion travelled the world in his youth. But the world is not a nice place and it seems he had to run fast.
artifacts.descZh: 大法师泰尔兰在年轻的时候曾环游世界。但是这个世界并不是那么美好以至于我们的大法师不得不飞速逃跑。

artifacts.name: Lunar Shield
artifacts.desc: A large section of chitin removed from Nimisil. It continues to give off a strange white glow.
artifacts.descZh: 一块从尼米希尔身上剥离下来的巨大甲壳。它持续发出奇异的白色光芒。

artifacts.name: Malediction
artifacts.desc: The land withers and crumbles wherever this cursed axe rests.
artifacts.descZh: 无论这把斧头在哪里，大地都会枯萎和凋零。

artifacts.name: Malslek the Accursed's Hat
artifacts.desc: This black hat once belonged to a powerful mage named Malslek, in the Age of Dusk, who was known to deal with beings from other planes. In particular, he dealt with many powerful demons, until one of them, tired of his affairs, betrayed him and stole his power. In his rage, Malslek set fire to his own tower in an attempt to kill the demon. This charred hat is all that remained in the ruins.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶黑色的帽子曾属于一名强大的法师马斯拉克，在黄昏纪时以交游位面之广而著称。值得一提的是，他还与许多恶魔进行了交易。直到某一天，一名恶魔厌烦了契约的约束而背叛了他并偷走了马斯拉克的力量。马斯拉克一气之下烧毁了自己的高塔，意图杀死这只恶魔。最终，废墟中只剩下了这顶帽子流传至今。

artifacts.name: Mandible of Ungolmor
artifacts.desc: This obsidian-crafted, curved blade is studded with the deadly fangs of the Ungolmor. It seems to drain light from the world around it.
artifacts.descZh: 这把黑曜石打造的利刃镶嵌有阿格尔莫的致命毒牙。光明在它周围消逝，无尽的黑暗缠绕着它。

items.value: inflicts spydric poison dealing 200 damage over 3 turns and pinning the target

artifacts.name: Mankini
artifacts.desc:
Revealing, green, fun.
#{bold}#If you never take it off and win you will gain a neat achievement and bragging rights!#{normal}#
artifacts.descZh:
性感，绿色，有趣。
#{bold}#如果你在全程不脱下它的情况下通关你将可以得到一个成就和吹牛的权利！#{normal}#

specialDesc.en: You have never taken it off.
specialDesc.zh: 你还没有把它脱下过。

artifacts.name: Masochism
artifacts.desc:
Stolen flesh,
	Stolen pain,
	To give it up,
	Is to live again.
artifacts.descZh:
窃取血肉,
    窃取苦痛,
    舍弃本我,
    秽尸复苏。

specialDesc.en:
Reduces all damage by %d%% of current vim or 50%% of the damage, whichever is lower; but at the cost of vim equal to 5%% of the damage blocked. 
Current Bonus: %d
specialDesc.zh:
降低所有伤害相当于%d%%当前活力值的数值，但不超过伤害值的50%%;降低伤害时，消耗相当于5%%伤害量的活力值。
当前活力值：%d

artifacts.name: Medical Urgency Vest
artifacts.desc: This light leather armour features a special medical injector.
artifacts.descZh: 这件轻型皮革背心配备有一个装用的医疗注射器。

artifacts.name: memories of archmage Varil
artifacts.nameZh: 大法师沃利尔的回忆录
artifacts.desc: A collection of thoughts and memories of the archmage Varil, during the Age of Dusk.
artifacts.descZh: 黄昏纪中大法师沃利尔的想法和记忆。

artifacts.name: memories of Artelia Firstborn
artifacts.desc: The memories of the first elf ever to awaken.
artifacts.descZh: 传说中第一个醒来的精灵的记忆。

artifacts.name: Mercy
artifacts.desc: This dagger was used by a nameless healer during the Age of Dusk. The plagues that ravaged his town were beyond the ability of mortal man to treat, so he took to using his dagger to as an act of mercy when faced with hopeless patients. Despite his good intentions, it is now cursed with dark power, letting it kill in a single stroke against those already weakened.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄匕首曾被黄昏纪一名无名的治疗师使用。瘟疫袭击了城镇，而医者终究是凡人，他只能用这柄匕首结束那些绝望的病人的痛苦。尽管初衷是好的，这柄匕首现在已经被黑暗力量污染，用它伤害虚弱的敌人威力更大。

items.value: deals 60 physical damage increased by 1% for each 1% life the target has lost

artifacts.name: Merkul's Second Eye
artifacts.desc: This bow is said to have been the tool of an infamous dwarven spy. Rumours say it allowed him to "steal" the eyes of his enemies. Adversaries struck were left alive, only to unknowingly divulge their secrets to his unwavering sight.
artifacts.descZh: 这把弓据说属于一位臭名昭著的矮人间谍。更有传言称，这把弓能帮助他利用所有敌人的眼睛。被射中的敌人虽然不会丧命，但却没有意识到自己的眼睛已经把周围的秘密全都泄漏给了他。

artifacts.name: Mighty Girdle
artifacts.desc: This girdle is enchanted with mighty wards against expanding girth. Whatever the source of its wondrous strength, it will prove of great aid in the transport of awkward burdens.
artifacts.descZh: 这条腰带被赋予了神秘的魔力来对抗膨胀的腰围。不管它蕴含着的是何种力量，它总是能在你负重不足时助你一臂之力。

artifacts.name: Mirror Shards
artifacts.desc: Said to have been created by a powerful mage after his home was destroyed by a mob following the Spellblaze. Though he fled, his possessions were crushed, burned, and smashed. When he returned to the ruins, he made this amulet from the remains of his shattered mirror.
artifacts.descZh: 据说是由一位强大的魔法师在他的家园被猎魔行动的暴民摧毁后制造。虽然他逃脱了追捕，但是他的财产都被破坏和烧毁殆尽。当他回去时，发现家里已成废墟，墙上的斑驳和地上的碎片说明了这里曾遭到怎样的劫难。最终，他捡起了其中一块镜子残片，将其做成了这副项链。

usePower.name: create a reflective shield (50%% reflection rate, %d strength, based on Magic) for %d turns
usePower.nameZh: 制造反射护盾（50%%反射率，%d吸收量，基于魔法）持续%d回合。

artifacts.name: Mirrorazor
artifacts.desc:
The experiment of a mad chronomancer, this strange device is a portal into a backwards universe!
That is, everything there spins the opposite direction.
I guess it probably grinds things pretty well.
artifacts.descZh:
这是一个疯狂的时空法师的实验，这个奇怪的装置是进入反向宇宙的入口！
也就是说，那里的一切都朝相反的方向旋转。
我想它可能磨得很好。

usePower.name: 5 turns after use, mirror yourself across the map (centered around the location you were standing when activated).
usePower.nameZh: 使用后5回合，将自己镜像到地图上（以激活时所站的位置为中心）。

artifacts.name: Mnemonic
artifacts.desc: As long as you wear this ring, you will never forget who you are.
artifacts.descZh: 只要你戴上这枚戒指，你永远不会忘却。

specialDesc.en: When using a mental talent, gives a 10% chance to lower the current cooldowns of up to three of your wild gift, psionic, or cursed talents by three turns.
specialDesc.zh: 每次使用精神技能时，有10%几率减少至多3个自然、灵能、诅咒系的技能冷却时间3回合。

artifacts.name: Molten Skin
