artifacts.desc: This mass of fused molten bone from the Heavy Sentinel radiates intense power. It still glows red with the heat of the Sentinel's core, and yet seems to do you no harm.
artifacts.descZh: 这件由笨重的森提内尔身上扒下的骨甲散发着阵阵高温。由于森提内尔核心的强大能量，它一直在发红发亮。不过它似乎不会伤害到你。

artifacts.name: Monolith Armour
artifacts.desc: This 'armour' seems to mostly consist of chunks of a rune etched stone somehow fused with a highly flexible black mesh. The titanic pieces of stone would undoubtedly deflect any blow thrown at you, but you would need obscene strength just to move while wearing this. The glyphs and runes carved into the chunks sometimes light up of their own accord, letting out small bursts of magic.
artifacts.descZh: 这块护甲似乎是由一整块符文巨石组成，它与某种高度灵活的黑色网状物融为一体。毋庸置疑，巨大的石块可以阻挡对你身上的任何打击，但你需要巨大的力量才能穿着它移动。刻在上面的符文有时候会自动点亮，放出小型的魔法爆炸。

specialDesc.en:
15% chance when hit to shatter reality around you creating rifts to help you (free cast of a Reality Fracture talent, level 4). This effect has a 30 turns cooldown.
#PURPLE#If your constitution drops below requirement while using it, it is so heavy you will automatically unequip it. Beware.#LAST#
specialDesc.zh:
击中时有15%的几率撕裂周围的现实，在身边创造一个时空裂痕来帮助你（免费释放一次等级4的实境撕裂）这个效果的冷却时间为30回合。
#PURPLE#如果在你使用它的时候你的体质值降低到了装备的需求以下，因为它太重了，你会立刻解除装备。要小心#LAST#

artifacts.name: Moon
artifacts.desc: A viciously curved blade that a folk story says is made from a material that originates from the moon.  Devouring the light around it, it fades.
artifacts.descZh: 一把弧形的匕首，传说是用取自月亮的材料打造的。它吞噬了周围的光芒，显得黯淡。

artifacts.name: Morrigor
artifacts.desc: This heavy, ridged blade emanates magical power, yet as you grasp the handle an icy chill runs its course through your spine. You feel the disembodied presence of all those slain by it. In unison, they demand company.
artifacts.descZh: 这把沉重的，有着锯齿状刀刃的长剑正在向外散发强大的魔法波动，当你握住剑时，一阵寒意从剑柄传来，直刺灵魂。你仿佛感觉到了葬身剑下的亡灵，他们渴望着更多同伴的到来。

items.value: swallows the victim's soul, gaining a new power

artifacts.name: Mummified Egg-sac of Ungolë
artifacts.desc: Dry and dusty to the touch, it still seems to retain some shadow of life.
artifacts.descZh: 摸起来又干又脏，它看起来仍旧保存着一些生命的气息。

usePower.name: summon up to 2 spiders
usePower.nameZh: 召唤2个蜘蛛。

artifacts.name: Murderfang's Surekill
artifacts.desc:
"Murderfang came over yesterday, raving about this idea for a steamgun he had. He described it in great detail, everything, except for how it would actually work.
What do you even grip it by? Insisted I make it though, left some design notes.
They all just say 'make it really flashy'.
 
-Pizurk, Master Tinker
artifacts.descZh:
屠牙昨天突然跑过来，和我讨论他对蒸汽枪的灵感。他详细地描述了这把枪的构造，几乎说了每一点细节，除了一件事——这把枪该怎么用。
如何才能握住这样一把枪呢？尽管如此，我还是坚持着把它做出来，虽然有一些设计没有实现。
他们都说这把枪做的棒极了。

——工匠大师皮兹鲁克

items.value: Burst apart, dealing physical damage equal to 25% of the original damage in a ball of radius 1.

artifacts.name: Nacrush's Decimator
artifacts.desc: Nacrush was known for a tendency towards overkill.
artifacts.descZh: 纳克拉什因其滥杀而闻名。

specialDesc.en: Knocks you back when fired.
specialDesc.zh: 开火时击退自己。

artifacts.name: Nature's Blessing
artifacts.unidedName: supple leather armour entwined with willow bark
artifacts.desc: Worn by Protector Ardon, who first formed the Ziguranth during the mage wars between the Humans and the Halflings.  This armour is infused with the powers of nature, and protected against the disruptive forces of magic.
artifacts.descZh: 曾被守护者亚当穿著，他在魔法战争中首次于人类和半身人之间建立了伊格兰斯。这件护甲被灌注了大自然的能量，并被用来对抗魔法破坏者。

artifacts.name: Nature's Vengeance
artifacts.desc: This thick-set mace was used by the Spellhunter Vorlan, who crafted it from the wood of an ancient oak that was uprooted during the Spellblaze.  Many were the wizards and witches felled by this weapon, brought to justice for the crimes they committed against nature.
artifacts.descZh: 这把加粗的权杖曾属于猎魔人沃尔兰，他从一棵在魔法大爆炸中被连根拔起的古老橡树中取材制造了它。众多法师和女巫倒在了这把武器之下，他们对自然犯下的罪行得到了制裁。

artifacts.name: necromancer poem
artifacts.desc: A poem written by a... Necromancer?
artifacts.descZh: 一首由……死灵法师？所写的诗歌

artifacts.name: Neira's Memory
artifacts.desc: Ages ago this belt was worn by Linaniil herself in her youth, using its power she shielded herself from the Spellblaze rain of fire, but naught could she do for her sister Neira.
artifacts.descZh: 许多年前这根腰带是年轻时的莱娜尼尔穿戴的，在魔法大爆炸的火焰之中它的力量保护了她，但却保护不了她的姐妹尼耶拉。

usePower.name: surround yourself with a magical shield (strength %d, based on Magic) for %d turns
usePower.nameZh: 制造一层魔法护盾，(强度%d，基于魔法) ，持续%d回合。

artifacts.name: Nexus of the Way
artifacts.desc: The vast psionic force of the Way reverberates through this gemstone. With a single touch, you can sense overwhelming power, and hear countless thoughts.
artifacts.descZh: 巨大的意念力在这颗宝石之中回响，仅仅轻触就可以让你获得无穷的力量和无限的思维。

artifacts.name: Nightsong
artifacts.desc: A pitch black ring, unadorned. It seems as though tendrils of darkness creep upon it.
artifacts.descZh: 一枚纯黑色的戒指。似乎无尽的黑暗缠绕着它。

artifacts.name: Nimbus of Enlightenment
artifacts.desc:
By all accounts, just an ordinary cooking pot with an array of antennae haphazardly soldered onto it. An attached manual contains nothing but fifty pages of deranged gibberish, nonsensical diagrams and lines upon lines of numbers with no apparent pattern or reason to them. 

Putting this on your head may not be the best idea.
artifacts.descZh:
从任何角度看，都只是一个装着天线的平凡的烹饪锅。附赠的使用手册写满了50页的疯言疯语、错乱的程序代码与杂乱无章的数字，没有任何可用的信息。

直接把它戴在头上似乎不是个好点子。

specialDesc.en:
They are out to get you.
This is not real this is not real this is not real.
specialDesc.zh:
他们来了。
这不是真的不是真的不是真

artifacts.name: Nithan's Force
artifacts.desc: This powerful sling is said to have belonged to a warrior so strong his shots could knock down a brick wall...
artifacts.descZh: 这个投石索曾属于大力士尼森，他投出的弹药能击倒砖墙，很可能得到了魔法的帮助。

artifacts.name: Obliterator
artifacts.desc: This massive hammer strikes with deadly force. Bones crunch, splinter and grind to dust under its impact.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄巨大的锤子挥击时拥有能粉碎骨头的巨力。

artifacts.name: of halfling feet
artifacts.desc: Notes about... Halfling feet??
artifacts.descZh: 有关…半身人的脚？？的笔记

artifacts.name: Omniscience
artifacts.desc: This white cap is plain and dull, but as the light reflects off of its surface, you see images of faraway corners of the world in the sheen."
artifacts.descZh: 这顶白色的帽子朴素、笨拙，但是，当光线在它的表面反射时，你看到了世界的极远方。

usePower.name: reveal the surrounding area (range 20)
usePower.nameZh: 展露周围20码的地形

artifacts.name: On Adventuring
artifacts.desc: Fragments of a fabled traveler.
artifacts.descZh: 一个传说中的旅行者的记录。

artifacts.name: Oozing Heart
artifacts.desc: This mindstar oozes a thick, caustic liquid. Magic seems to die around it.
artifacts.descZh: 这只灵晶在不断的向外渗出粘糊糊的液体。魔法似乎消逝在它周围。

artifacts.name: Orc Feller
artifacts.desc: During the invasion of Eldoral the Halfling Rogue Herah is said to have slain over one hundred orcs while defending a group of refugees.
artifacts.descZh: 据说在艾德瑞尔战争中，半身人盗贼赫拉在保护一群难民时杀死了100多个兽人。

artifacts.name: Overburst
artifacts.desc: "Have you ever fired a shot into a group of monsters and thought 'there must be a better way?' Well now, there is!"
artifacts.descZh: 你曾经试过向一群怪兽中发射一粒粒弹药，然后觉得一定有更好的方法？好了，这就是了。

items.value: Release a burst of shrapnel, dealing physical damage equal to your steampower in a cone from the target of radius 4.

artifacts.name: Overclocked Radius
artifacts.desc:
Faced with the petty quandaries of 'conventional physics', some mad tinker must have coated this sawblade with a fine sheathe of dilated time to maximize its speed.
 
There were ...side effects.
artifacts.descZh: 在传统物理学的困境前，某些疯狂的工程师将时间流嵌入链锯中，以达到最大速度。\n\n当然，这样存在一些小小的副作用。

specialDesc.en: Attack speed increases with paradox, up to 250% at 1000 paradox.
specialDesc.zh: 攻击速度随紊乱值增加，1000紊乱时为250%.

items.value: increase paradox by a random amount

artifacts.name: Overcutter
artifacts.desc: Earlier steamsaws were notably not meant to be used with one hand.
artifacts.descZh: 显然早期的蒸汽锯不是为单手使用设计的。

artifacts.name: Overseer
artifacts.desc: Fragments of the Mindwall's power still inhabit this cracked, ancient gem.
artifacts.descZh: 意念之墙的力量碎片仍然依附在这块破裂的古老宝石上。

usePower.name: either mentally dominate or psychically stun (depending on immunities) a nearby target within range %d for %d turns (success depends on Mindpower)
usePower.nameZh: 精神控制或物理震慑（根据免疫类型而定）半径%d码内的随机目标，持续%d回合（成功率基于精神强度）

items.value: reduces mental save

artifacts.name: Payload
artifacts.desc: "I never really liked that village anyway." - Charlta, Mad Inventor
artifacts.descZh: "我一点都不喜欢那个村庄。" - 疯狂科学家，查尔塔

items.value: Boom.

artifacts.name: Pearl of Life and Death
artifacts.desc: A pearl, three times the size of a normal pearl, that glitters in infinite colours, with slight patterns ever shifting away.
artifacts.descZh: 一颗比其他要大三倍的珍珠。它的表面不断的闪烁着光芒，似乎有奇妙的花纹在其表面一闪而逝。

artifacts.name: Pendant of the Sun and Moons
artifacts.desc: This small pendant depicts a hematite moon eclipsing a golden sun and according to legend was worn by one of the Sunwall's founders.
artifacts.descZh: 一个小小的垂饰，雕刻着红月吞日的图案。传说其主人是太阳堡垒的建立者之一。

specialDesc.en: All your damage is converted and split into light and darkness.
specialDesc.zh: 你造成的所有伤害被转化均分为光系和暗影伤害。

artifacts.name: Penitence
artifacts.desc: A powerful staff sent in secret to Angolwen by the Shaloren, to aid their fighting of the plagues following the Spellblaze. Its power is not to harm, but to heal and protect.
artifacts.descZh: 永恒精灵密送到安格利文，用以对抗魔法大爆炸所引起灾难的强大法杖。

usePower.name: cure up to %d diseases or poisons (based on Magic)
usePower.nameZh: 治愈至多%d项疾病和毒素。(基于魔法)

artifacts.name: Perseverance
artifacts.desc:
It is said that the preferred weapons of the krog is a mace in one hand and a sword in the other. One hand to spread the message of the Zigurath, the other to see that message through to the end.
The sword symbolizes the krogs committment to their task of fighting against the forces of the arcane. With each slash the krog would endevor to continue, until at last their opponents would fall.
artifacts.descZh:
人们说克罗格首选的武器是一手拿剑一手拿锤。用一只手传播伊格兰斯的讯息，而用另一只手来让自己能够坚持到把这一信息传达到最后。
剑象征着克罗格坚守着他们对抗奥术力量的任务。直到最后一个敌人倒下之前，克罗格都会用这把剑坚持战斗。

items.value: restore 7 stamina and equilibrium

artifacts.name: Persistent Will
artifacts.desc:
During the Age of Dusk a rash of anti-magic activities took place in the Nargol Kingdom immediately after the Spellblaze. Citizens would turn on those with magical powers, burning them alive on stakes of wood. When the authorities found the perpetrators they executed them and planted their heads on stakes throughout their capital city.
Despite this however, the citizenry continued to burn alive the enemies of nature. Unbeknownst to the authorities, the heads of the dead perpetrators continued to spread their message long after their deaths.

This stake of wood appears to one of those used to prop up one of the executed heads. It has seemingly absorbed the will of the head it propped up, and holding it you can hear the Ziguranth's message echo through your mind.
artifacts.descZh:
在黄昏纪的魔法大爆炸后，纳格尔王国迅速爆发了反对法师的活动。民众包围那些使用魔法的人，将他们绑在木头上活活烧死。纳格尔王国镇压了这些肇事者，把他们的人头插在遍布首都的柱子上。
然而尽管如此，人民还是继续与大自然的敌人战斗。当局所不知道的是，那些死去的反抗者的头颅在他们死后仍然继续传递着他们的反抗意志。

这段木头似乎是曾经戳着一个被处决的人的人头的。它似乎吸收了被它刺穿的头颅的意志，拿着它，你可以感受到伊格兰斯的意志在你在你的脑海回响。

usePower.name: convince all non arcane users in radius 10 to turn on their spellcasting friends for 6 turns (chance increases with your Mindpower)
usePower.nameZh: 使半径10码范围内的非奥术魔法使用者攻击奥术魔法使用者，持续6回合（几率随精神强度提升）

artifacts.name: Petrified Wood
artifacts.desc: A piece of the scorched wood taken from the remains of Snaproot.
artifacts.descZh: 从远古树精身上得到的木头残片。

artifacts.name: Pick of Dwarven Emperors
artifacts.desc: This ancient pickaxe was used to pass down dwarven legends from one generation to the next. Every bit of the head and shaft is covered in runes that recount the stories of the dwarven people.
artifacts.descZh: 这把古老的十字镐被用来一代代的往下传颂矮人的传奇。从镐头到镐把每一寸都覆盖着记述矮人故事的诗歌。

artifacts.name: Piercing Gaze
artifacts.desc: This gigantic shield has a stone eye embedded in it.
artifacts.descZh: 这个巨大的盾牌上嵌有一个石质的眼睛

artifacts.name: Pinwheel
artifacts.desc: "Create new, exciting connections in other people's lives, such as between their feet and the floor!"
artifacts.descZh: 在他人的生命中建立全新，有趣的连接，比如他们的脚和地板！

items.value: 15% chance to pin the target

artifacts.name: Plague-Fire Sceptre
artifacts.desc: The flames of Mal'Rok can be more stubborn than most. When they run out of fuel they have been known go out of their way to find more.
artifacts.descZh: 玛·洛克的火焰比一般的火焰更加顽强。当它们无物可燃时，它们知道去哪里寻找。

usePower.name: fire a bolt of plaguefire, dealing damage over time based on your magic stat
usePower.nameZh: 召唤出一团疫火，造成基于魔力值的持续伤害。

specialDesc.en: Plaguefire detonates when its victim dies, spreading to other enemies up to two times.
specialDesc.zh: 疫火感染的生物死亡时，疫火将传播到附近的敌人。至多传播2次。

artifacts.name: Planar Beacon
artifacts.desc: A strange orb of demonic origins. It glows with a surreal red light.
artifacts.descZh: 从恶魔手里拿到的奇怪的球体，它正闪耀着超现实的红光。

artifacts.name: Plate Armor of the King
artifacts.desc: Beautifully detailed with images of King Toknor's defence of Last Hope. Despair fills the hearts of even the blackest villains at the sight of it.
artifacts.descZh: 精细描绘着国王图库纳为最后的希望浴血的影像。即便是彻头彻尾的恶棍看到它，心底也会充满深深的绝望。

artifacts.name: Plate of the Blackened Mind
artifacts.desc: This deep black armor absorbs all light that touches it. A dark power sleeps within, primal, yet aware. When you touch the plate, you feel dark thoughts creeping into your mind.
artifacts.descZh: 这件黑色的胸甲吸收了附近的所有光线。你能感受到其中沉睡着一股邪恶的力量。当你触摸它时，你感到黑暗的思想在不断的涌现在你的脑海。

artifacts.name: Potion of Martial Prowess
artifacts.desc: This potent elixir can give insights into martial combat to those unlucky enough to ignore the basics.
artifacts.descZh: 这种强大的药剂可以给那些忽视基础的人提供最基本的武学技巧。

artifacts.name: Pouch of the Subconscious
artifacts.desc: You find yourself constantly fighting an urge to handle this strange pouch of shot.
artifacts.descZh: 你情不自禁的想使用这袋弹药。

items.value: 50% chance to reload 1 ammo

artifacts.name: Pressure-enhanced Slashproof Combat Suit
artifacts.desc: A simple leather armour of excellent facture that has been craftily enhanced with hidden miniature steam engines to enhance reflexes and provide safety features.
artifacts.descZh: 简约的皮甲背后隐藏着精巧的系统，能感应压力启动，确保安全性能。

specialDesc.en: When you take a hit of more than 10% of your total life the suit's motors activate for the next turn, displacing you before any blow could hit you.
specialDesc.zh: 当你受到超过10%总生命值的伤害后，引擎启动，下回合内，每次受到攻击时，将自动移位来避免伤害。

artifacts.name: Pressure-enhanced Slashproof Combat Suit
artifacts.desc: A simple leather armour of excellent facture that has been craftily enhanced with hidden miniature steam engines to enhance reflexes and provide safety features.
artifacts.descZh: 简约的皮甲背后隐藏着精巧的系统，能感应压力启动，确保安全性能。

specialDesc.en: When you take a hit of more than 10% of your total life the suit's motors activate fo the next turn, displacing you before any blow could hit you.
specialDesc.zh: 当你承受超过你10%最大生命值的一击的时候，套装的发动机会激活，免疫所有伤害，直到下一个回合。

artifacts.name: Pressurizer
artifacts.desc: This cloak hides and protects a series of powerful steam compressors.
artifacts.descZh: 这件斗篷隐藏并保护着一套蒸汽压缩机。

artifacts.name: Primal Infusion
artifacts.desc: This wild infusion has evolved.
artifacts.descZh: 这个纹身已经进化了

artifacts.name: Prothotipe's Prismatic Eye
artifacts.nameZh: 普罗斯泰普的七彩之眼
artifacts.desc: This cracked gemstone looks faded with age. It appears to have once been the eye of a golem.
artifacts.descZh: 这枚损坏的宝石看起来似乎有一定的年月了。种种迹象表面它曾经是某个傀儡的眼珠。

specialDesc.en: Casts lasers on spellcast when worn or imbued.
specialDesc.zh: 当装备或镶嵌时，施放法术时附加激光

artifacts.name: Prox's Lucky Halfling Foot
artifacts.nameZh: 普洛克斯的幸运半身人脚
artifacts.desc:
A large hairy foot, very recognizably a halfling's, is strung on a piece of thick twine. In its decomposed state it's hard to tell how long ago it parted with its owner, but from what look like teeth marks around the ankle you get the impression that it wasn't given willingly.
It has been kept somewhat intact with layers of salt and clay, but in spite of this it's clear that nature is beginning to take its toll on the dead flesh. Some say the foot of a halfling brings luck to its bearer - right now the only thing you can be sure of is that it stinks.
artifacts.descZh:
一只用细线串起来的巨大毛脚，很显然这是一位半身人的。目前的状态，很难讲它多久以前被割了下来，但是从脚踝处的齿痕来看，应该不是出于自愿。
它的外面有一层盐和粘土，被很好的保护着，尽管如此，大自然还是剥夺了它的活力，它已经成为了一块死肉。有人说，半身人的脚可以带来好运，但是现在唯一可确认的是——它臭死了！

specialDesc.en:
Detects traps.
Removes (25%% chance) up to three stuns, pins, or dazes each turn%s
specialDesc.zh:
侦查陷阱。
25%%几率解除至多3个震慑、定身或眩晕效果。%s

artifacts.name: Psionic Fury
artifacts.desc: This mindstar constantly shakes and vibrates, as if a powerful force is desperately trying to escape.
artifacts.descZh: 这颗灵晶在不停的震动，仿佛其中有一股强大的力量试图从中逃脱。

usePower.name: release a wave of psionic power, dealing %0.2f mind damage (based on Willpower) to all within radius %d
usePower.nameZh: 释放灵能冲击波，造成%0.2f精神伤害（基于意志），伤害半径%d。

artifacts.name: Punae's Blade
artifacts.desc: This very thin sword cuts through the air with ease, allowing remarkably quick movement.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄超乎寻常的薄刃能轻松地在空气中挥舞，让你行动更为迅速。

artifacts.name: Qog's Essentials
artifacts.desc: A hypospray full of ...something. There is no telling what you're injecting yourself with.
artifacts.descZh: 一个无针注射器，里面装满了*某种*液体。你完全不知道你给自己注射了什么。

usePower.name: Gain a random beneficial effect
usePower.nameZh: 获得一个随机增益效果

artifacts.name: Quasit's Skull
artifacts.desc: Some enterprising adventurer seems to have noticed the skin of quasits is actually tougher than most metals, and fashioned this helm from one. Shame about the smell.
artifacts.descZh: 一些有魄力的冒险者已经注意到了夸塞魔的皮肤其实比大多数金属都要坚硬，这个头盔就是一个夸塞魔的颅骨制成的。呣，气味浓郁。

artifacts.name: Quiver of Domination
artifacts.desc: Powerful telepathic forces emanate from the arrows of this quiver. The tips appear dull, but touching them causes you intense pain.
artifacts.descZh: 箭袋中的箭矢中散发出一股强大的意念力，尖端虽然看上去不锋利，但是当你触摸时却让你感到剧烈的疼痛。

items.value: dominate the target

artifacts.name: Quiver of the Sun
artifacts.desc: This strange orange quiver is made of brass and etched with many bright red runes that glow and glitter in the light.  The arrows themselves appear to be solid shafts of blazing hot light, like rays of sunshine, hammered and forged into a solid state.
artifacts.descZh: 这个奇特的橙色箭壶由黄铜制成，在阳光下，你可以看到壶身铭刻着许多亮红色的发光符文。箭矢似乎配有燃烧的箭杆，就像被锻造过的阳光。

artifacts.name: Radiance
artifacts.desc: This pristine golden cloak flows with a wind that seems to be conjured from nowhere. Its inner surface is a completely plain white, but the outside shines with intense light.
artifacts.descZh: 这件古朴的金色斗篷随风漂浮着，内侧洁白无一物，外侧闪耀着强烈的光芒。

artifacts.name: Ramroller
artifacts.desc: "So we were thinking. You know what's better than saws? Really BIG saws. Unfortunately, no one could lift them. So we came up with an innovative new solution: Mount them on a motorized platform, allowing easy transportation and unparalleled cutting power!"
artifacts.descZh: 我们曾经这么想：你知道比锯子更好的是什么吗？巨大的锯子。可惜没人能够拿得动它们。所以我们想了一个新颖的主意：将他们安装在一个移动的平台上，以便让我们方便的运输，并获得无与伦比的切割能力。

specialDesc.en: Moving builds up a stacking movement speed (caps at 25%) and damage bonus (caps at double). Hitting removes the bonus.
specialDesc.zh: 移动会带来移动速度加成(最高25%)和伤害加成(最高50%)。攻击后加成消失。

artifacts.name: Razorblade, the Cursed Waraxe
artifacts.desc:
This mighty axe can cleave through armour like the sharpest swords, yet hit with all the impact of a heavy club.
It is said the wielder will slowly grow mad. This, however, has never been proven - no known possessor of this item has lived to tell the tale.
artifacts.descZh:
这把强力的斧头可以像剑一样劈开护甲，却能造成如同钝器一般的重击。
据说持有者会慢慢变得疯狂。这个，不管怎样，从来没有被证实过——没有任何持有者能活到揭开真相。

artifacts.name: Razorlock
artifacts.desc:
This intricate set of steamsaws lock together in a nearly indecipherable system.
They sure seem sharp though.
artifacts.descZh: 这套蒸汽链锯以奇特的方式锁在一起，看上去非常锋利

artifacts.name: Revenant
artifacts.desc: The joints of this armor creak ominously, the frame bends and heaves, almost as if breathing. The scratch and crack of metal mutters of suffering, of loss, perseverance and revenge.
artifacts.descZh: 关节不祥的咯吱作响，骨架弯曲突起的呼吸。划痕与裂纹是金属的低语，有关苦楚、失去、坚持与复仇。

specialDesc.en: Status resistances shift over time to match the statuses you are being hit by.
specialDesc.zh: 依据你中的负面状态改变你的状态免疫

artifacts.name: Ring of Growth
artifacts.desc: This small wooden ring has a single green stem wrapped around it. Thin leaves still seem to be growing from it.
artifacts.descZh: 这枚小巧的戒指上缠绕着一根藤蔓，藤蔓似乎仍然在不断的吐出新叶。

artifacts.name: Ring of Lost Love
artifacts.desc:
This crimson ring has a palpable bittersweet feel to it.
Inside it is engraved the phrase #{italic}#"To Aeryn, my love, my life. Yours forever. John"#{normal}#
artifacts.descZh:
这个深红色指环明显充满了甜蜜与苦涩。
它内侧刻有如下短语#{italic}#“献给我的挚爱，我的生命，艾琳。永远爱你的，约翰。”#{normal}#

specialDesc.en: You feel something is #{bold}#very wrong#{normal}# with this ring.
specialDesc.zh: 你感觉这个戒指#{bold}#非常不对劲#{normal}#.

artifacts.name: Ring of Mental Save (+6)
artifacts.desc: A ruby-studded ring.
artifacts.descZh: 一只镶有红宝石的戒指。

artifacts.name: Ring of the Archlich
artifacts.desc:
This ring is filled with an overwhelming, yet restrained, power. It lashes, grasps from its metal prison, searching for life to snuff out. You alone are unharmed.
Perhaps it feels all the death you will bring to others in the near future.
artifacts.descZh: 这枚戒指含有强大的力量，但是没有显现出来。它将生命拉入金属牢笼之中，而你自己不受伤害。似乎它感觉在不久的将来你会带来无尽的死亡。

artifacts.name: Ring of the Dead
artifacts.desc: This ring is imbued with powers from beyond the grave. It is said that those who wear it may find a new path when all other roads turn dim.
artifacts.descZh: 这枚戒指充溢着坟墓的气息。据说佩戴它的人会在走投无路时发现新的道路。

specialDesc.en: Will bring you back from death, but only once!
specialDesc.zh: 能将你从死亡边缘拯救1次

artifacts.name: Ring of the War Master
artifacts.desc: A blade-edged ring that radiates power. As you put it on, strange thoughts of pain and destruction come to your mind.
artifacts.descZh: 散发能量、边缘开刃的戒指。当你戴上它时，陌生的痛苦念头和毁灭的情景涌入你脑海。

artifacts.name: Ritch Claws
artifacts.desc: A pair of sharply honed gauntlets made from the claws of Ritch Impalers.
artifacts.descZh: 一对用锋刺里奇的爪子磨成的尖锐的手套。

artifacts.name: River's Fury
artifacts.desc: This gorgeous and ornate trident was wielded by Lady Nashva, and when you hold it, you can faintly hear the roar of a rushing river.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄华丽的三叉戟曾被纳纱瓦女士使用过，当你握紧它时，你会听到奔腾河流的怒吼。

artifacts.name: Robe of Force
artifacts.desc: This thin cloth robe is surrounded by a pulsating shroud of telekinetic force.
artifacts.descZh: 这件薄薄的长袍被一团神秘的精神力量所包围。

usePower.name: send out a range %d beam of kinetic energy, dealing %0.2f to %0.2f physical damage (based on Willpower and Cunning) with knockback
usePower.nameZh: 发射长度 %d 的动能射线，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点物理击退伤害（基于意志和灵巧）

artifacts.name: Robe of the Archmage
artifacts.desc: A plain elven-silk robe. It would be unremarkable if not for the sheer power it radiates.
artifacts.descZh: 朴素的精灵丝绸长袍。如果不是它放射出的惊人威力，它真的毫不起眼。

artifacts.name: Robes of Deflection
artifacts.desc: This set of robes seems to shine with metallic colors.
artifacts.descZh: 这套长袍闪烁着金属般的光辉。

artifacts.name: Rod of Annulment
artifacts.desc: You can feel magic draining out around this rod. Even nature itself seems affected.
artifacts.descZh: 你可以感受到枝条周围的魔力流失，甚至它自己也似乎受到了影响。

usePower.name: put up to 3 of the target's runes, infusions or talents on cooldown for 3-5 turns (range %d)
usePower.nameZh: 将半径%d内的一个目标的至多3个纹身、符文或技能打入3-5回合的冷却。

artifacts.name: Rod of Entropy
artifacts.desc: This rod seems to make light die around it. You feel tired just looking at it.
artifacts.descZh: 这根魔杖似乎能够熄灭周围的光。光是看着它你就觉得很累了。

usePower.name: temporarily causes the target to receive entropic backlash from any healing they receive for %d turns up to %d%% of the healing done. This effect scales with your Magic stat.
usePower.nameZh: 暂时使目标从他们的治疗中受到熵反冲，在%d回合内受到%d%%治疗量伤害。效果受魔力值加成。

artifacts.name: Rod of Sarrilon
artifacts.desc: A plain looking ceremonial rod. It has connections with Time that even chronomancers do not yet understand.
artifacts.descZh: 看上去普普通通的法杖，但是它和时间的神秘联系连时空法师都不清楚。

artifacts.name: Rod of Spydric Poison
artifacts.desc: This rod carved out of a giant spider fang continuously drips venom.
artifacts.descZh: 这根法杖由巨大蜘蛛的毒牙雕刻而成，它往下不断的滴落毒液。

usePower.name: shoot a bolt of spydric poison out to range %d, dealing %0.2f nature damage (based on Magic) over %d turns while rendering the target unable to move
usePower.nameZh: 发射蜘蛛毒素, 对%d码内的敌人造成%0.2f点自然伤害(基于魔法), 并使其在%d回合内无法移动

artifacts.name: Rogue Plight
artifacts.desc: No rogue blades shall incapacitate the wearer of this armour.
artifacts.descZh: 盗贼之刃将不能加于装备者之身。

specialDesc.en: Transfers a bleed, poison, or wound to its source or a nearby enemy every 4 turns.
specialDesc.zh: 每4回合将一项流血、毒素或伤口效果转移给效果来源或者附近的敌人

artifacts.name: Rogue's Gallery
artifacts.desc: Lined with reactive mechanisms, this cloak is equipped for any situation you might possibly encounter, and several you couldn't possibly encounter!
artifacts.descZh: 内衬各种机械装置，这件披风包含着让你可以应对任何你有可能或不可能遇到的情况的特殊装备！

usePower.name: cause the next damage you deal to inflict crippling poison (does not recharge until used), dealing minor poison damage and causing your target to have a 10% chance to fail all talents
usePower.nameZh: 令你下一次伤害附带致残毒素效果，有10%几率使技能使用失败。

specialDesc.en: On falling below 20% of your max life, releases a cloud of smoke, confusing nearby enemies and giving you stealth and a chance to avoid incoming damage for 5 turns.
specialDesc.zh: 生命掉落至20%以下时，释放一阵烟雾,混乱周围生物，令你潜行并有一定几率免疫伤害，持续5回合。

artifacts.name: rogues do it from behind
artifacts.desc: A poem written for a rogue?
artifacts.descZh: 一首由盗贼所写的诗歌？

artifacts.name: Rope Belt of the Thaloren
artifacts.desc: The simplest of belts, worn for centuries by Nessilla Tantaelen as she tended to her people and forests. Some of her wisdom and power have settled permanently into its fibers.
artifacts.descZh: 最朴素的腰带，被奈希拉·坦泰兰在领导她的人民和森林期间穿戴了几个世纪。这条腰带永久的保存了她的部分智慧和力量。

artifacts.name: Rune of Reflection
artifacts.desc: You can see your own image mirrored in the surface of this silvery rune.
artifacts.descZh: 你可以在这块银色的符文表面看到自己的倒影。

artifacts.name: Runed Skull
artifacts.desc: Dull red runes are etched all over this blackened skull.
artifacts.descZh: 这块黑色头骨上遍布着暗红色的符文。

artifacts.name: Rungof's Fang
artifacts.desc: A fang from the great warg, Rungof, still covered in blood.
artifacts.descZh: 巨型座狼郎格夫之牙，上面仍被血痕覆盖。

artifacts.name: Ruthless Grip
artifacts.desc: Crafted for a warlord who wanted to keep his subjects under a stralite grip. Dark thoughts went into the making of these gauntlets, literally.
artifacts.descZh: 一个军阀为了永远掌握他的臣民而制造的.黑暗的思想被真正的灌注进去这些手套里.

artifacts.name: S.H. Spear
artifacts.desc:
This gun is engraved with a strange material which focuses mental powers.
It seems like your mind will operate even faster with this equipped.
artifacts.descZh:
这把枪被一种能强化精神力量的神秘物质雕刻。
装备着它，你的大脑似乎更加灵敏了。

artifacts.name: Sanguine Shield
artifacts.desc: Though tarnished and spattered with blood, the emblem of the Sun still manages to shine through on this shield.
artifacts.descZh: 尽管这个盾牌被鲜血染上并玷污了，但是阳光会继续照耀着它。

artifacts.name: Scale Mail of Kroltar
artifacts.desc: A heavy shirt of scale mail constructed from the remains of Kroltar, whose armour was like tenfold shields.
artifacts.descZh: 一件用库洛塔的遗物打造的重甲，她的护甲有盾牌的十倍重。

artifacts.name: Scattermind
artifacts.desc: A linen pouch of jagged mindstar fragments, each radiating a palpable sense of confusion and pain. They must have made up an impressive whole originally, before some cretin turned it to bits.
artifacts.descZh: 一个亚麻布袋中装着锯齿状的灵晶碎片，让人清晰的感受到混乱和痛苦。在某个混蛋把它打成碎片之前，它一定是一个令人无法忘怀的整体。

items.value: strike the target with one of Mind Sear, Psychic Lobotomy, or Sunder Mind, at random.

artifacts.name: Sceptre of the Archlich
artifacts.desc: This sceptre, carved of ancient, blackened bone, holds a single gem of deep obsidian. You feel a dark power from deep within, looking to get out.
artifacts.descZh: 这根权杖上有古老焦黑的白骨雕刻，镶嵌着一颗黑曜石，你感受到里面有一股黑暗力量呼之欲出。

artifacts.name: Scorched Boots
artifacts.desc: The master blood mage Ru'Khan was the first orc to experiment with the power of the Sher'Tul farportals in the Age of Pyre.  However, that first experiment was not particularly successful, and after the explosion of energy all that could be found of Ru'Khan was a pair of scorched boots.
artifacts.descZh: 血魔导师鲁·克汉是派尔纪第一个使用夏·图尔远程传送门进行试验的兽人。试验不是很成功，能量爆炸后，只剩下了一双烧焦的靴子。

artifacts.name: Scorpion's Tail
artifacts.desc: A long whip of linked metal joints finished with a viciously sharp barb leaking terrible venom.
artifacts.descZh: 一条金属串接的长鞭，尾端锋利的邪恶倒刺渗透着毒液。

artifacts.name: Seeds of the Black Tree
artifacts.desc: This writhing mass of tentacles appears to have infested a mindstar, creating some bizarre fusion between natural and unnatural. The once clear gem now seems more like a shard of black obsidian with tentacles striking out from it like whips. You do not want to think of the implications of this horror being able to fuse with Nature itself.
artifacts.descZh: 这团扭曲的触手似乎感染了一块灵晶，在自然和超自然之间形成了一种奇异的混合。曾经清晰的宝石现在看起来更像一块黑曜石碎片，触手在上面伸出，宛如鞭子一般。你无法想象，恐魔竟然能够和大自然混合。

items.value: 15% chance to cast Tendrils Eruption level 3 on your target

artifacts.name: Serpent's Glare
artifacts.desc: A thick venom drips from this mindstar.
artifacts.descZh: 凝厚的毒液不断地从这个灵晶上滴落。

artifacts.name: Serpentine Cloak
artifacts.desc: Cunning and malice seem to emanate from this cloak.
artifacts.descZh: 这件斗篷散发着恶毒和狡诈的气息。

artifacts.name: Shantiz the Stormblade
artifacts.desc: This surreal dagger crackles with the intensity of a vicious storm.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄超现实的匕首周围环绕有强大的风暴

items.value: Causes lightning to strike and destroy any projectiles in a radius of 10, dealing damage and dazing enemies in a radius of 5 around them.

artifacts.name: Shard of Crystalized Time
artifacts.desc: An iridescent shard of violet crystal.  Its light ebbs and flows, sometimes fast and sometimes slow, keeping pace with the chaotic streams of time itself.  It makes you feel both old and young, a newborn child and an ancient being, your flesh simply one instance in a thousand refractions of a single timeless and eternal soul.
artifacts.descZh: 这是一块紫色的闪光碎片。闪光时缓时快，时而亮如星辰，时而黯淡无光。握着它时，你感到自己既年轻又苍老，时而觉得自己是一个年轻人，时而又觉得自己像是活了几千年。你的肉体在短暂的瞬间似乎跨越了千年，但是灵魂却永恒不变。

artifacts.name: Shard of Insanity
artifacts.desc: A deep red light glows from within this damaged amulet of black stone. When you touch it, you can hear voices whispering within your mind.
artifacts.descZh: 从这条损坏的黑色项链上放出暗红色的光亮，当你触摸它时，你能听到脑海里的窃窃私语。

artifacts.name: Shieldsmaiden
artifacts.desc: Myths tell of shieldsmaidens, a tribe of warrior women from the northern wastes of Maj'Eyal. Their martial prowess and beauty drew the fascination of swaths of admirers, yet all unrequited. So began the saying, that a shieldsmaiden's heart is as cold and unbreakable as her shield.
artifacts.descZh: 传说中的女武神，来自马基埃亚尔世界的北方荒地。她的美貌和力量吸引了众多爱慕者前去，然而所有人都空手而归。因此，有这样一句谚语：女武神的心同她的盾一样冰冷而不可打破。

specialDesc.en: Granted talent can block up to 1 instance of damage each 10 turns.
specialDesc.zh: 提供技能:每十回合能抵挡一次攻击。

artifacts.name: Shifting Boots
artifacts.desc: Those leather boots can make anybody as annoying as their former possessor, Draebor.
artifacts.descZh: 这双靴子可以使任何人像它以前的主人小恶魔德瑞宝一样淘气。

usePower.name: blink to a nearby random location within range %d (based on Magic)
usePower.nameZh: 随机传送到%d码范围内的位置(基于魔法)

artifacts.name: Shoes of Moving Quickly
artifacts.desc: Accurately? Less so.
artifacts.descZh: 精确吗？并不。

specialDesc.en: You move 3 spaces at once.
specialDesc.zh: 一次走3格

artifacts.name: Shoes of Moving Slowly
artifacts.desc:
Fast does not always win.

#GOLD#Rumoured to be able to combine with the Shoes of Moving Quickly.
artifacts.descZh:
快不一定是好事。

#GOLD#有人说这可以和疾行之靴结合。

specialDesc.en: Each turn you spend not moving gain a buff for 2 defense and armour. Stacks up to 12 times.
specialDesc.zh: 每个你没有移动的回合都能得到2点防御和护甲值增益。最多叠加12次。

artifacts.name: Signal
artifacts.desc: An odd, stubby gun with a large, red barrel.
artifacts.descZh: 一把奇特、粗短的枪，装有红色的枪管。

artifacts.name: Silent Blade
artifacts.desc: A thin, dark dagger that seems to meld seamlessly into the shadows.
artifacts.descZh: 一把锋利，阴暗，完全融入了阴影中的匕首。

items.value: Enter stealth for 3 turns.

artifacts.name: Silk Current
artifacts.desc: This deep blue robe flows and ripples as if pushed by an invisible tide.
artifacts.descZh: 这件深蓝色的法袍荡起涟漪，仿佛有一股看不见的浪潮在涌动。

artifacts.name: Skeletal Claw
artifacts.desc: This whip appears to have been made from a human spine. A handle sits on one end, a sharply honed claw on the other.
artifacts.descZh: 这根鞭子看上去像是人类的脊骨做成，一端有一个柄，另一端是一个磨光的爪子。

artifacts.name: Skin of Many
artifacts.desc: The stitched-together skins of many creatures. Some eyes and mouths still decorate the robe, and some still live, screaming in tortured agony.
artifacts.descZh: 缝在一起的许多人皮。有些眼睛和嘴巴依然待在这件袍子上，并且有一些仍然活着，在被酷刑折磨的痛苦中尖啸。

artifacts.name: Skullcleaver
artifacts.desc: A small but sharp axe, with a handle made of polished bone.  The blade has chopped through the skulls of many, and has been stained a deep crimson.
artifacts.descZh: 一把小巧而锋利的斧头，斧柄由打磨过的骨头制成。这把斧头打破了许多头骨，并被染成了鲜红色。

artifacts.name: Skysmasher
artifacts.desc: The discovery of rockets has proved incredibly dangerous. It is not always clear for whom.
artifacts.descZh: 火箭的发明被证明为极其危险。尚不清楚对谁。

artifacts.name: Sludgegrip
artifacts.desc: These gloves are coated with a thick, green liquid.
artifacts.descZh: 这双手套被粘稠的绿色液体覆盖。

artifacts.name: Snow Giant Wraps
artifacts.desc: Two large pieces of leather designed to be wrapped about the hands and the forearms.  This particular pair of wraps has been enchanted, imparting the wearer with great strength.
artifacts.descZh: 两大块皮革被设计成包裹手和前臂。这副独特的护手经过了附魔，可给予穿戴者巨大的力量。

artifacts.name: Spectral Blade
artifacts.desc: This sword appears weightless, and nearly invisible.
artifacts.descZh: 这把剑飘渺无形。

artifacts.name: Spectral Cage
artifacts.desc: This ancient, weathered lantern glows with a pale blue light emanating from several ghostly forms trapped within.  The metal is icy cold to the touch.
artifacts.descZh: 这个古老、褪色的灯笼放射出淡蓝色的光芒。它的金属表面摸上去像冰一样冷。

usePower.name: release a will o' the wisp that will explode against your foes for %d cold damage (based on your Magic)
usePower.nameZh: 放出鬼火，可以对你的敌人自爆，造成%d寒冷伤害（基于魔法）

artifacts.name: Spellblade
artifacts.desc: Mages sometimes have funny ideas. Archmage Varil once learned how to handle a sword and found he preferred wielding it instead of his staff.
artifacts.descZh: 法师总是时不时冒出古怪的点子。大法师沃利尔曾学会了怎样擎起一柄剑，同时发现自己对耍剑比玩法杖更感冒。

artifacts.name: Spellblaze Echoes
artifacts.desc: This ancient charm still retains a distant echo of the destruction wrought by the Spellblaze
artifacts.descZh: 当你戴上这个古老的项链，似乎耳边仍回荡着魔法大爆炸的回响。

usePower.name: unleash a destructive wail, destroying terrain and dealing %0.2f physical damage (based on Magic) in a radius of %d
usePower.nameZh: 释放毁灭哀嚎，摧毁地形，造成 %0.2f 物理伤害 (基于魔法) 伤害半径 %d

artifacts.name: Spellblaze Shard
artifacts.desc: This jagged crystal glows with an unnatural light. A strap of cloth is wrapped around one end, as a handle.
artifacts.descZh: 这块锯齿状的水晶放射出异常的亮光，它的一端绑着几圈布条当作握把。

artifacts.name: Spellcrusher
artifacts.desc: This large steel greatmaul has thick vines wrapped around the handle.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄巨大的铁制巨锤，其手柄上覆盖着一层厚厚的藤蔓。

items.value: 50% chance to shatter magical shields

artifacts.name: Spelldrinker
artifacts.desc:
Countless mages have fallen victim to the sharp sting of this blade, betrayed by those among them with greed for ever greater power.
Passed on and on, this blade has developed a thirst of its own.
artifacts.descZh:
无数法师曾殒命这匕首之下，被那些渴望力量的同伴背叛。
时光流逝，匆匆不还，这柄匕首也开始渴望杀戮。

items.value: steals up to 50 mana from the target

artifacts.name: Spellhunt Remnants
artifacts.desc: These once brilliant voratun gauntlets have fallen into a deep decay. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, curing the world of their influence.
artifacts.descZh: 你从这副锈迹斑斑的臂铠上勉强能看出其曾经的辉煌。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。

usePower.name: destroy an arcane item (of a higher tier than the gauntlets)
usePower.nameZh: 摧毁一件奥术装备（比臂铠材质级别高）

specialDesc.en: Can't be worn by those with arcane powers.
specialDesc.zh: 使用奥术力量的人无法穿戴。

artifacts.name: Spellhunter's Guide part 1: How to Detect a Spellweaver
artifacts.nameZh: 猎魔人指南第一部分：怎样辨别法师
artifacts.desc: The definitive guide to hunting magic users.
artifacts.descZh: 狩猎魔法使用者的权威指南。

artifacts.name: Spellhunter's Guide part 2: How to Battle a Magic-User
artifacts.nameZh: 猎魔人指南第二部分：怎样与法师战斗
artifacts.desc: The definitive guide to hunting magic users.
artifacts.descZh: 狩猎魔法使用者的权威指南。

artifacts.name: Spellhunter's Guide part 3: How to Kill a Magic-User
artifacts.nameZh: 猎魔人指南第三部分：如何杀死法师
artifacts.desc: The definitive guide to hunting magic users.
artifacts.descZh: 狩猎魔法使用者的权威指南。

artifacts.name: Spider-Silk Robe of Spydrë
artifacts.desc: This set of robes is made wholly of spider silk. It looks outlandish and some sages think it came from another world, probably through a farportal.
artifacts.descZh: 这套礼服完全用蛛丝制成。它看起来充满异国风情，一些智者推测它来自另一个世界，很可能穿越过时空之门。

artifacts.name: Spider's Fangs
artifacts.desc: A dedicated technician seems to have built pockets of spider venom into these rounds. It's not clear how happy the spiders were about this.
artifacts.descZh: 一位热心的技师似乎将成吨的蜘蛛毒液注入了这些子弹里。不知道蜘蛛对此有多么高兴。

specialDesc.en: %s

items.value: bursts into an cloud of spydric poison, pinning those inside (with a 10 turn cooldown)

artifacts.name: Spinal Cage
artifacts.desc: A gross mass of spinal matter hastily assembled into armour.
artifacts.descZh: 一团脊髓物质，差不多可以用来当做护甲

artifacts.name: Staff of Arcane Supremacy
artifacts.desc:
A long slender staff, made of ancient dragon-bone, with runes emblazoned all over its surface in bright silver.
It hums faintly, as if great power is locked within, yet alone it seems incomplete.
artifacts.descZh: 一根又细又长的法杖，由远古龙骨制成，它通体铭刻着银色的符文。它会发出微弱的嗡嗡声，似乎有一股强大的力量被锁在了里面，整体来看，它似乎是不完整的。

artifacts.name: Staff of Bones
artifacts.desc: A staff made out of the bones of fallen foes. Disgustingly powerful.
artifacts.descZh: 由被击败的敌人的白骨制成的法杖。令人厌恶而强大。

specialDesc.en: It seems willing and able to talk to you (use Command Staff).
specialDesc.zh: 它似乎愿意和你交谈（使用法杖掌控）

artifacts.name: Staff of Destruction
artifacts.desc: This unique-looking staff is carved with runes of destruction.
artifacts.descZh: 这个品相独特的法杖上刻印着毁灭符文。

artifacts.name: Star
artifacts.desc: Legend tells of a blade, shining bright as a star. Forged from a material fallen from the skies, it glows.
artifacts.descZh: 传说之刃，闪耀如星。由取自陨石的材料锻造而成，它散发着光芒。

artifacts.name: Star Shot
artifacts.desc: Intense heat radiates from this powerful shot.
artifacts.descZh: 子弹中放射出极高的热量。

items.value: sets off a powerful explosion

artifacts.name: Starcaller
artifacts.desc: A light staff covered in stralite and gems. It seems to reflect the light of the stars even in daylight.
artifacts.descZh: 一把被蓝锆石和宝石覆盖的轻型法杖。即使在白天，似乎也在反射着星星的光芒。

artifacts.name: Steam Powered Armour
artifacts.desc: Using small steam engines and the miracles of the latest automation discoveries you are able to create Steam Powered Armour. A full plate armour that helps your movement and has intrinsic protection mechanisms.
artifacts.descZh: 使用小型蒸汽机和你最新发现的自动化技术，你可以制造蒸汽动力装甲。这个板甲增强你的行动能力并提供强大的防护能力。

artifacts.name: Steam Powered Boots
artifacts.desc: Boots. But with steam power!
artifacts.descZh: 蒸汽动力！

specialDesc.en: Generate %d steam each time you walk.
specialDesc.zh: 每当你移动时，获得%d蒸汽。

artifacts.name: Steam Powered Gauntlets
artifacts.desc: Gauntlets. But with steam power!
artifacts.descZh: 蒸汽动力！

artifacts.name: Steam Powered Helm
artifacts.desc: A Helmet. But with steam power!
artifacts.descZh: 蒸汽动力！

artifacts.name: Steamcatcher
artifacts.desc: There's an old saying that most of your body heat escapes through your head. It's not true of body heat, but strangely, is actually true of steam.
artifacts.descZh: 传说人体热量大部分从头部散失。对于体热来说并不是这样，但奇怪的是，蒸汽是从头部散失的。

specialDesc.en: On taking fire damage: Gain 5% of the damage as steam.
specialDesc.zh: 受到的火焰伤害5%转化为蒸汽。

artifacts.name: Steel Helm of Garkul
artifacts.desc: A great helm that belonged to Garkul the Devourer, one of the greatest orcs ever to live.
artifacts.descZh: 这是迄今为止最伟大的兽人，吞噬者加库尔的头盔。

artifacts.name: Stimulus
artifacts.desc: This injecting unit is complemented by a belt of tiny vials, containing some sickly yellow liquid. The papers describe the contents as 'invigorating' and 'increasing the combat potency.'
artifacts.descZh: 这个注射单元由皮带栓起的小型药瓶组成，里面装满了粘稠的黄色液体。论文描述这些液体可以‘使人精力充沛’并‘增加作战能力’。

usePower.name: inject yourself with painkillers, reducing all incoming damage by 5. Stacks up to 5 times. When the effect ends, lose 5% of your max life per stack
usePower.nameZh: 朝自己注射镇痛剂，降低所有伤害5点。最多叠加5次。当效果结束是，每层叠加会让你损失5%最大生命值

artifacts.name: Stinger
artifacts.desc: Is that... an ovipositor?
artifacts.descZh: 这是……产卵管？

artifacts.name: Stone Gauntlets of Harkor'Zun
artifacts.desc: Fashioned in ancient times by cultists of Harkor'Zun, these heavy granite gauntlets were designed to protect the wearer from the wrath of their dark master.
artifacts.descZh: 古时候由哈克祖的狂热崇拜者制作，这副花岗岩臂铠被设计为可以保护穿戴者免于遭受黑暗之主的暴怒。

artifacts.name: Storm Bringer's Gauntlets
artifacts.desc: This pair of fine mesh voratun gauntlets is covered with glyphs of power that spark with azure energy.  The metal is supple and light so as not to interfere with spell-casting.  When and where these gauntlets were forged is a mystery, but odds are the crafter knew a thing or two about magic.
artifacts.descZh: 这副细孔沃瑞钽臂铠被闪烁着蓝色能量的雕文所覆盖。这种金属柔软且轻盈，不会对施法造成阻碍。制造这副手套的时间和地点都是一个谜，但是可以确认的是，制造者对于魔法技术有一定的了解。

artifacts.name: Storm Fury
artifacts.desc: This dragonbone longbow is enhanced with bands of steel, which arc with intense lightning. Bolts travel up and down the string, ignorant of you.
artifacts.descZh: 这把龙骨长弓由精钢镶制而成，一道道电弧缠绕在其身上，闪电球在其弓弦上徘徊，但是却绕过了你的手臂。

specialDesc.en: Automatically fires lightning bolts every game turn at nearby enemies dealing %d to %d lightning damage based on Magic with a chance to inflict Daze.
specialDesc.zh: 自动发射闪电攻击附近敌人，造成%d到%d基于魔法的闪电伤害，有几率使之眩晕。

artifacts.name: Stormcutter
artifacts.desc: "Great for combat, cooking, and shaving! We accept no responsibility for ruined follicles."
artifacts.descZh: "适合战斗、烹饪甚至刮胡子！我们并不负责处理刮破皮的问题。"

items.value: actions/melee
actions/melee
deal lightning damage to the target based on cunning with a 25% chance to daze, and arc to up to 3 targets.

artifacts.name: Stormfront
artifacts.desc: The blade glows faintly blue, and reflects a sky full of stormy clouds.
artifacts.descZh: 剑身泛着淡淡的蓝色,反射出了满天的乌云.

items.value: inflicts either shocked or wet, chosen at random

artifacts.name: Stormlash
artifacts.desc: This steel plated whip arcs with intense electricity. The force feels uncontrollable, explosive, powerful.
artifacts.descZh: 这根钢质的鞭子缠绕着许多电弧。你可以感受这根鞭子上散发出的力量强大且不可控制。

usePower.name: strike an enemy within range %d (for 100%% weapon damage as lightning) and release a radius %d burst of electricity dealing %0.2f to %0.2f lightning damage (based on Magic and Dexterity)
usePower.nameZh: 攻击距离 %d 内的敌人，造成 100%% 闪电武器伤害并在半径 %d 内释放电弧，造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点闪电伤害 (基于魔法和敏捷)

items.value: Focus the lightning forces on an enemy

artifacts.name: Summertide
artifacts.desc: A bright light shines from the center of this shield. Holding it clears your mind.
artifacts.descZh: 从这面盾牌的中心放射出耀眼的光芒，当你紧握这面盾牌时，你的思维变得清晰。

usePower.name: send out a range %d beam, lighting its path and dealing %0.2f to %0.2f light damage (based on Willpower and Cunning)
usePower.nameZh: 发射长度 %d 的射线，照亮路径，并造成 %0.2f 到 %0.2f 点光系伤害(基于意志和灵巧)

items.value: releases a burst of light

artifacts.name: Summertide Phial
artifacts.desc: A small crystal phial that captured Sunlight during the Summertide.
artifacts.descZh: 一个小水晶瓶里捕获了夏日的阳光。

usePower.name: call light, dispelling darkness and lighting tiles in radius 20.(%d power, based on Willpower)
usePower.nameZh: 召唤阳光，驱除黑暗并照亮20格内的地面。 (%d强度，基于意志 )

specialDesc.en: When attacking in melee, deals 15 light damage and lights tiles in radius 1.
specialDesc.zh: 近战攻击时，在1码半径内造成15光系伤害并照亮区域。

artifacts.name: Sunstone
artifacts.desc: This strange stone shines with the heat of the Sun. Perhaps it could be used to generate more steam?
artifacts.descZh: 这块奇怪的石头发出太阳的光和热。或许它可以用来产生更多的蒸汽？

artifacts.name: Surefire
artifacts.desc: This tightly strung bow appears to have been crafted by someone of considerable talent. When you pull the string, you feel incredible power behind it.
artifacts.descZh: 这把做工精良的弓相传由一位不知名的大师打造。当你拉动弓弦时，你能感受到这把弓蕴藏着难以置信的力量。

artifacts.name: Sword of Potential Futures
artifacts.desc: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the untapped potential of time.
artifacts.descZh: 传说这把长剑是一对兵器中的其中一个；这对兵器打造于时空守卫最初的年代。对于未经训练的持有者来说它还不是那么完善；对于时空守卫来说，它将随着时间展现威力。

artifacts.name: Swordbreaker
artifacts.desc: This ordinary blade is made of fine, sturdy voratun and outfitted with jagged hooks along the edge. This simple appearance belies a great power - the hooked maw of this dagger broke many a blade and the stride of many would-be warriors.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄普通的匕首是由精制坚硬的沃瑞钽制成的，配有锯齿钩边。看似平凡的外表背后潜藏着强大的力量——它破坏过诸多刀刃，收割走那些战士的生命和未来。

specialDesc.en: Can block like a shield, potentially disarming the enemy.
specialDesc.zh: 可以像盾牌一样格挡，并缴械目标。

items.value: Breaks enemy weapon.

artifacts.name: Tale of the Moonsisters
artifacts.desc: The creation of Eyal's moons.
artifacts.descZh: 埃亚尔月亮的创造。

artifacts.name: Talosis' Counterpoint
artifacts.desc: It's said that Talosis never lost an argument. Now you know why.
artifacts.descZh: 据说泰勒西斯从没有输过一场争吵。现在你知道原因了。

artifacts.name: Tarrasca
artifacts.desc: This massive suit of plate boasts an enormous bulk and overbearing weight. Said to belong to a nameless soldier who safeguarded a passage across the bridge to his village, in defiance to the cohorts of invading orcs. After days of assault failed to fell him, the orcs turned back. The man however, fell dead on the spot - from exhaustion. The armor had finally claimed his life.
artifacts.descZh: 这件结实硕大的板甲有着夸张的体积和难以想象的重量。相传这件板甲属于一位不知名的士兵，为了抵御洪水般的兽人军团入侵他的家乡，这名士兵守护在通向他村庄的大桥上。经过几天几夜惨烈的进攻，兽人没能击倒他，最终敌人撤退了。而这名传奇般的士兵，也因为精疲力竭当场倒毙，这件盔甲最终夺去了他的生命。

usePower.name: slow the movement speed of all creatures (including yourself) within range 5 by 40% for 3 turns
usePower.nameZh: 将范围5内所有生物的移动速度（包括你自己）降低40%，持续3回合。

specialDesc.en:
When your effective movement speed (global speed times movement speed) is less than 100%%, reduces all incoming damage by a percent equal to the speed detriment (up to 70%%).
Current reduction bonus: %d%%
specialDesc.zh:
当你的有效移动速度（整体速度乘移动速度）小于100%%的时候，降低所有伤害，比例相当于当前移动速度和100%%的差距，但最大不超过70%%。
当前减伤比例：%d%%

artifacts.name: tattered paper scrap
artifacts.desc: A hastily written message.
artifacts.descZh: 匆忙写下的信息。

artifacts.name: tattered paper scrap
artifacts.desc: A hastily written message.
artifacts.descZh: 匆忙写下的信息。

artifacts.name: Telekinetic Core
artifacts.desc: This heavy torque appears to draw nearby matter towards it.
artifacts.descZh: 这副沉重的项圈将周围的所有物体拉向它。

artifacts.name: Telos Spire of Power
artifacts.desc: Telos was an extremely powerful mage during the Age of Dusk, hated by his peers and feared by the common folk; he was hunted for a long while. He finally fell from his place of power, Telmur, but his spirit still lingers.
artifacts.descZh: 泰勒斯是黄昏纪的一位强大法师，为对手所嫉恨，为弱者所惧怕。最终，虽然他陨落在了他的所在之处——泰尔玛，但是他的灵魂仍长存于世。

usePower.name: turn into a corrupted losgoroth (poison, disease, cut and confusion immune; converts half damage into life drain; does not require breath) for 10 turns
usePower.nameZh: 转变为一只堕落的洛斯格罗斯(毒素、疾病、撕裂和混乱免疫)十回合，转换一半伤害为生命吸收，不需要呼吸。

artifacts.name: Telos's Staff (Bottom Half)
artifacts.desc: The bottom part of Telos' broken staff.
artifacts.descZh: 泰勒斯折断法杖的下半部。

artifacts.name: Telos's Staff (Bottom Half)
artifacts.desc: The bottom part of Telos' broken staff.
artifacts.descZh: 泰勒斯折断法杖的下半部。

artifacts.name: Telos's Staff (Top Half)
artifacts.desc: The top part of Telos' broken staff.
artifacts.descZh: 泰勒斯破损法杖的上半部分。

artifacts.name: Telos's Staff Crystal
artifacts.desc: A closer look at this pure white crystal reveals that it is really a plethora of colors swirling and scintillating.
artifacts.descZh: 近距离欣赏这颗纯净的白水晶，你会发现很多种颜色在上面盘旋闪耀。

usePower.name: combine with a staff
usePower.nameZh: 安装至法杖

artifacts.name: Temporal Augmentation Robe - Designed In-Style
artifacts.desc: Designed by a slightly quirky Paradox Mage, this robe always appears to be stylish in any time the user finds him, her, or itself in. Crafted to aid Paradox Mages through their adventures, this robe is of great help to those that understand what a wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey mess time actually is. Curiously, as a result of a particularly prolonged battle involving its fourth wearer, the robe appends a very long, multi-coloured scarf to its present wearers.
artifacts.descZh: 被有些古怪的时空法师设计出来，无论穿戴者在哪个时代，这袍子都显得格外时髦。它为协助时空法师冒险而制作。这件法袍对掌握时间多样性的人来说有着巨大的作用。有趣的是，由于它第四任主人参与了一场相当漫长的战斗，长袍上附带了一条很长的幻彩领带。

artifacts.name: Temporal Rift
artifacts.desc: Some mad Chronomancer appears to have affixed a handle to this hole in spacetime. It looks highly effective, in its own strange way.
artifacts.descZh: 某些疯狂的时空法师在时空中开了一个洞。它似乎很有效，但是会以自己诡异的方式运转。

artifacts.name: Thalore-Wood Cuirass
artifacts.desc: Expertly hewn from the bark of trees, this wooden armor provides excellent protection at a low weight.
artifacts.descZh: 由树皮制成，做工相当精巧，重量很轻，却能提供很好的防护。

artifacts.name: Thaloren-Tree Longbow
artifacts.desc: In the aftermath of the Spellblaze, the Thaloren had to defend their forests against foes and fires alike. Many of the trees died despite the efforts of the Elves to save them. Their wood was fashioned into a bow to be wielded against the darkness.
artifacts.descZh: 在魔法大爆炸的余波里，自然精灵不得不从敌人和大火中保卫他们的森林。尽管精灵们奋力的抢救它们，许多树还是死掉了。它们的遗体被打造成一张弓用来抵御黑暗的侵袭。

artifacts.name: The Black Boots
artifacts.desc: "It's a treacherous road to the top of the world."
artifacts.descZh: 背叛之路，直通天际

specialDesc.en: Grants 2.5% movement speed for each point of Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加2.5%移动速度

artifacts.name: The Black Core
artifacts.desc: "Lock your soul away, and death will never reach you."
artifacts.descZh: 锁住灵魂，死亡莫及。

specialDesc.en: Grants spellpower equal to your Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加1点法术强度

artifacts.name: The Black Crown
artifacts.desc: "For the demon who has everything."
artifacts.descZh: 魔中之魔，加冕为王

specialDesc.en: Increases all saves by your Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加1点全豁免

artifacts.name: The Black Maul
artifacts.desc: "A fitting weapon for the Champion."
artifacts.descZh: 冠军之锤，举重若轻

artifacts.name: The Black Plate
artifacts.desc: "Wreckage all about you. Is there anything left inside?"
artifacts.descZh: 己身若残，何物能存?

specialDesc.en: Grants physical power equal to your Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加1%点物理强度

artifacts.name: The Black Ring
artifacts.desc: "An innocuous bauble. Until you look through the hole."
artifacts.descZh: 勿视其中，安然无恙

specialDesc.en: Grants spell-crit equal to half of your Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加0.5%法术暴击率

artifacts.name: The Black Spike
artifacts.desc: "All the better to pierce the heart of the world."
artifacts.descZh: 世界之心，终将刺穿

specialDesc.en: Increases all damage penetration by 1% for each point of your Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加1%抗性穿透

artifacts.name: The Black Wall
artifacts.desc: "With this, no one will ever harm you again."
artifacts.descZh: 披坚持盾，众莫能伤

specialDesc.en: Increases all resists by 0.4% for each point of your Shadow Power.
specialDesc.zh: 每点“阴影强度”增加0.4%全体抗性

artifacts.name: The Cage
artifacts.desc: Nothing will ever reach you again.
artifacts.descZh: 任何事物都无法再碰触你。

specialDesc.en: You are immune to mental status effects.
specialDesc.zh: 你免疫精神状态效果。

artifacts.name: The Calm
artifacts.desc: This green robe is engraved with icons showing clouds and swirling winds. Its original owner, a powerful mage named Proccala, was often revered for both his great benevolence and his intense power when it proved necessary.
artifacts.descZh: 这件绿色长袍上刻有云朵和漩涡。它最初的主人，大法师普偌卡拉，因其善行和力量被人们敬畏

specialDesc.en: Your Lightning and Chain Lightning spells gain a 24% chance to daze, and your Thunderstorm spell gains a 12% chance to daze.
specialDesc.zh: 你的闪电术和连锁闪电有24%几率闪电风暴有12%几率令对方眩晕

artifacts.name: The Face of Fear
artifacts.desc: This mask appears to be carved out of the skull of a creature that never should have existed, malformed and distorted. You shiver as you look upon it, and its hollow eye sockets seem to stare back into you.
artifacts.descZh: 这件面具似乎用某种不明生物的头骨制成的，那是一种本不应该存在于世间的可怕生物，畸形并且扭曲。每当你盯着这个面具时，它那空洞的眼窝似乎也在注视着你，令你感到发自内心的颤栗。

artifacts.name: The Far-Hand
artifacts.desc: You can feel this strange metallic hand wriggling around, it feels as if space distorts around it.
artifacts.descZh: 你能感受到这个奇怪的金属手在扭动着，似乎周围的空间被扭曲了。

artifacts.name: The Forgotten
artifacts.desc: A strange mindstar, overgrown with granite and cracked. It seems incredibly ancient and horribly damaged, but still functions.
artifacts.descZh: 奇怪的灵晶，长满花岗岩而有裂缝。看上去非常古老，严重受损，但还能用。

usePower.name: confuse all enemies in radius 3 for 5 turns
usePower.nameZh: 混乱半径3码范围内的所有敌人，持续5回合。

artifacts.name: The Gaping Maw
artifacts.desc: This huge granite battleaxe is as much mace as it is axe.  The shaft is made of blackened wood tightly bound in drakeskin leather and the sharpened granite head glistens with a viscous green fluid.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄双手斧看起来更像狼牙棒，它的手柄是由黑木制成并包裹着一层蜉蝣皮，它的刃锋处闪耀着粘稠的绿色液体。

items.value: deal manaburn damage equal to your mindpower in a radius 3 cone

artifacts.name: The Great Evil
artifacts.desc: History of the horrors of magic.
artifacts.descZh: 有关魔法带来的恐怖的历史。

artifacts.name: The Guardian's Totem
artifacts.desc: This totem of ancient stone oozes a thick slime from myriad cracks. Nonetheless, you sense great power within it.
artifacts.descZh: 这个古老的石制图腾的石缝里不断涌出粘液。尽管如此，你仍能感受到它的巨大能量。

usePower.name: call forth an immobile antimagic pillar for 10 turns.  (It spits slime, pulls in, stuns, and burns the arcane resources of your foes, while emitting an aura of silence against them within range 5, and will silence you for 5 turns when first summoned.)
usePower.nameZh: 召唤一个无法移动的反魔图腾10回合。（它可以喷吐史莱姆、抓取怪物、对敌人施放法力燃烧效果，和在范围5码之内产生一个沉默光环。召唤它同时也会沉默你五回合。）

artifacts.name: The Jolt
artifacts.desc: This torque feels tingly to the touch, but seems to enhance your thinking.
artifacts.descZh: 这项圈摸起来让人觉得刺痛,但似乎增强了你的思考.

specialDesc.en:
Your mind is attuned to electricity.
Any lightning damage you do that is more than 10% of the victim's maximum life will attempt to brainlock the target.
Upon taking lightning damage >10% of your max life, your mind fires back, dealing 30% of the original damage as mind and trying to brainlock the target.
Upon taking mind damage >10% of your max life, you reflexively trigger the jolt, sending an arc of dazing lightning toward the target (damage based on mindpower).
This item can have up to 2 charges, with each charge having 4 turn cooldown.
specialDesc.zh:
你的精神与电力连接。
你对敌人造成的超过其最大生命值10%的闪电伤害时，会试图附加思维封锁效果。
当你受到相当于最大生命值10%的闪电伤害时，你的精神会发起反击，对敌人造成30%的原伤害，并试图附加思维封锁效果。
当你受到相当于最大生命值10%的精神伤害时，你会快速启动这个项圈，朝敌人射出一团震慑的闪电，伤害基于意志。
这个物品可以存储两次充能，每次充能冷却时间4回合。

artifacts.name: The Long-Arm
artifacts.desc: This gun has an absurdly long barrel. You wonder for whom it may have been designed.
artifacts.descZh: 这把枪的枪管长的出奇。你好奇这杆枪到底是为谁设计。

usePower.name: Focus your aim on a target, marking them for death - reducing their ranged defense by %d and their resistances by %d%%
usePower.nameZh: 击中精力瞄准一个目标，准备击杀对方——降低对方远程闪避%d，所有抗性%d%%

artifacts.name: The Lumberator
artifacts.desc: "Spread the wonders of nature even quicker than ever with this seed injecting steamsaw! Your former enemies will be freshly grown trees before you even know it!"
artifacts.descZh: 这台能够注射种子的蒸汽锯可以更快的传播自然的奇迹。在你意识到之前，你的敌人体内将会长出一棵树！

items.value: summon a treant (5 turn cooldown)

artifacts.name: The Oceans of Eyal
artifacts.desc: Thoughts about the impossibility of sea travel.
artifacts.descZh: 有关海洋航行的不可能性的思考。

artifacts.name: the perfect killing device
artifacts.desc: Some notes describing how to create poison gas traps, left by an unfortunate rogue.
artifacts.descZh: 一些描述如何制造毒气陷阱的笔记，由一位不幸的盗贼留下。

artifacts.name: The Shotgonne
artifacts.desc:
This huge steamgun can be loaded with more than one bullet so that multiple shots can be fired in a nasty cone of death.
It also seems to have been carefully balanced to work like a dual gun set.
artifacts.descZh:
这把巨大的蒸汽枪一次能装填多发子弹，并以锥形弹幕射出。
它精巧的设计令它能被双手持有。

specialDesc.en: When fired, shoots up to 4 extra shots at random foes with a radius 4 cone centered on the target.
specialDesc.zh: 发射时，在半径4的锥形范围内随机射出至多额外4发子弹。

artifacts.name: The Shunned Kruk
artifacts.desc: A history lesson.
artifacts.descZh: 历史课

artifacts.name: The story of my salvation
artifacts.desc: An old tale about the fear of magic.
artifacts.descZh: 有关魔法的恐怖的古老传说。

artifacts.name: The Titan's Quiver
artifacts.desc: These massive arrows are honed to a vicious sharpness, and appear to be nearly unbreakable. They seem more like spikes than any arrow you've ever seen.
artifacts.descZh: 巨大而尖锐的箭矢，不，与其说是箭，不如说是长钉。

items.value: pin the target to the nearest wall

artifacts.name: The Twisted Blade
artifacts.desc: You see flecks of gold in this vile mass of twisted steel, implying a once great origin. Whatever glory it once had is long gone, replaced by something far more sinister...
artifacts.descZh: 你在这块邪恶、扭曲的铁块上发现金色的斑点，暗示着它不同寻常的来历。然而曾经的辉煌，都已经成为了过去，如今已被更加邪恶的东西取代

items.value: Fully heal yourself. (15 turn cooldown)

artifacts.name: The Untouchable
artifacts.desc:
This rugged jacket is the subject of many a rural legend.
Some say it was fashioned by an adventurous mage turned rogue, in times before the Spellblaze, but was since lost.
All manner of shady gamblers have since claimed to have worn it at one point or another. To fail, but live, is what it means to be untouchable, they said.
artifacts.descZh: 这件破旧的夹克流传在许多乡村传说中。有人说，它属于魔法大爆炸前的一位法师转职成的盗贼，在此之后就遗失了。行行色色的人都声称曾穿过这件衣服，并且在千钧一发时救过他的命，他们说，这就是其名为“不可触及”的原因。

specialDesc.en: When you take a hit of more than 20% of your max life a shield is created equal to 130% the damage taken.
specialDesc.zh: 当你受到一次攻击损失超过20%最大生命值时，你获得一个护盾，可吸收那个数值130%的伤害。

artifacts.name: The Warped Boots
artifacts.desc: These blackened boots have lost all vestiges of any former glory they might have had. Now, they are a testament to the corruption of the Deep Bellow, and its power.
artifacts.descZh: 这些被玷污的靴子已经丧失了它们以前的荣耀，现在，它们只能作为深渊的存在以及腐蚀力量的证明。

artifacts.name: Therapeutic Platemail
artifacts.desc: This thick sealed armor utilizes a ventilation system to heal your wounds using a heated mist.
artifacts.descZh: 这个厚重的板甲配备有通风设备，可以使用加热的薄雾来治疗你。

usePower.name: cleanse up to 3 poisons or wounds detrimental effects
usePower.nameZh: 清除最多3个毒素和流血负面效果。

artifacts.name: Thermal Focus
artifacts.desc: Thermal energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
artifacts.descZh: 热能集中在这个灵晶的核心里.

artifacts.name: Thoughtcaster
artifacts.desc: From body, mind. From mind, body.
artifacts.descZh: 从物质中诞生意识。从意识中诞生物质。

specialDesc.en: On hitting with a mindstar, deal physical damage equal to your steampower in radius 1 around the target.
specialDesc.zh: 用灵晶命中时，在半径1范围内造成等于蒸汽强度的物理伤害

artifacts.name: Threads of Fate
artifacts.desc: Untouched by the ravages of time, this fine spun white cloak appears to be crafted of an otherworldly material that shifts and shimmers in the light.
artifacts.descZh: 这件精致的白色斗篷由异界材料制成，随光线变化而闪烁，永恒如新。

artifacts.name: Thundercrack
artifacts.desc: Through a combination of magic and airborne probes, these shots incite powerful bolts of lightning to strike your target from above, frying them and those around them!
artifacts.descZh: 这些弹药通过魔法和探针从天空引导强力的闪电冲击你的目标，灼烧目标及周边的单位。

items.value: a bolt of lightning strikes your target, dealing lightning damage to them and fire damage to those around them.

artifacts.name: Thunderfall
artifacts.desc: Tremendous power is concentrated in this heavy mace. Just dropping it can knock down nearby walls.
artifacts.descZh: 巨大的力量集中在这沉重的权杖里.只是掉落在地就可以摧毁附近的墙壁.

usePower.name: perform a melee strike against a target at up to range %d for an automatic critical hit as lightning damage
usePower.nameZh: 对范围 %d 内的一个目标造成自动暴击的闪电伤害。

artifacts.name: Tinkerer's Twinblaster
artifacts.desc:
This gun seems to be some experiment in firing multiple shots simultaneously.
The design is somewhat rudimentary, but it seems to work.
artifacts.descZh:
这把枪使用了实验性的技术一次射出多发子弹。
设计尚未成熟，但似乎还算能用。

artifacts.name: Tirakai's Maul
artifacts.desc: This massive hammer is formed from a thick mass of strange crystalline growths. In the side of the hammer itself you see an empty slot; it looks like a gem of your own could easily fit inside it.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄巨型锤子是用一种厚厚的古怪结晶体制成的，锤子里面能看到一个空槽，似乎很容易就能将宝石放进去。

usePower.name: imbue the hammer with a gem of your choice
usePower.nameZh: 把你喜欢的宝石镶嵌到锤子里。

specialDesc.en: No gem
specialDesc.zh: 没有宝石

artifacts.name: Titan
artifacts.desc: A gun sure to turn all to ash. As long as its nearby.
artifacts.descZh: 一把可以摧毁任何事物的枪，以及周边的一切。

artifacts.name: Titanic
artifacts.desc: This shield made of the darkest stralite is huge, heavy and very solid.
artifacts.descZh: 这面用最深邃的蓝锆石打造的盾牌巨大、沉重且相当坚固。

artifacts.name: Tome of Uttercold
artifacts.desc: This huge book is covered in slowly shifting patterns of ice. Yet they do not harm you.
artifacts.descZh: 这本巨大的书本被无尽的雪花所围绕。但它们不会伤害你。

artifacts.name: Tome of Wildfire
artifacts.desc: This huge book is covered in searing flames. Yet they do not harm you.
artifacts.descZh: 这本巨大的书本被明亮的火焰所围绕。但它们不会伤害你。

artifacts.name: Tooth of the Mouth
artifacts.desc: A huge tooth taken from the Mouth, in the Deep Bellow.
artifacts.descZh: 在无尽深渊中得到的一颗巨大牙齿。

artifacts.name: Tree of Life
artifacts.desc: This small tree-shaped totem is imbued with powerful healing energies.
artifacts.descZh: 你能在这根小巧的树状图腾上感受到强大的治愈能量。

usePower.name: take root increasing health by 300, armor by 20, and armor hardiness by 20%% but rooting you in place for 4 turns
usePower.nameZh: 扎根，增加300点生命、20点护甲和20%%护甲强度，但不能移动，持续4回合。

specialDesc.en: Heals all nearby living creatures by 5 points each turn.
specialDesc.zh: 治疗周围的生物，每回合恢复5点。

artifacts.name: Trident of the Tides
artifacts.desc:
The power of the tides rush through this trident.
Tridents require the exotic weapons mastery talent to use correctly.
artifacts.descZh: 这把三叉戟上流动着潮汐的力量。需习得异形武器天赋才能正确使用三叉戟。

artifacts.name: trollish poem
artifacts.desc: A poem written by a... troll?
artifacts.descZh: 一首由……巨魔？所写的诗歌

artifacts.name: Turbocutter
artifacts.desc: "Have you ever thought your steamsaws were just too slow? Well, have I got the thing for you..."
artifacts.descZh: 你曾经觉得你的蒸汽锯太慢了吗？那么，我有你需要的东西

specialDesc.en: Increases the speed bonus from Saw Wheels by 25%.
specialDesc.zh: 链锯轮滑速度增加25%

artifacts.name: Twilight's Edge
artifacts.desc: The blade of this sword seems to have been forged of a mixture of voratun and stralite, resulting in a blend of swirling light and darkness.
artifacts.descZh: 这柄长剑似乎是用沃瑞钽和蓝锆石混合制成，光与暗在不断旋转交融。

items.value: release a burst of light and dark damage (scales with Magic)

artifacts.name: Umbral Razor
artifacts.desc: This dagger seems to be formed of pure shadows, with a strange miasma surrounding it.
artifacts.descZh: 这只匕首覆盖着一层纯净的阴影，并且似乎有一团瘴气围绕着它。

items.value: 20% chance to make the target bleed shadows. You heal for 15 whenever you hit an enemy bleeding shadows.

artifacts.name: Umbraphage
artifacts.desc: This lantern of pale white crystal holds a sphere of darkness, that yet emanates light. Everywhere it shines, darkness vanishes entirely.
artifacts.descZh: 这个灰白色水晶制成的灯笼周围笼罩着一片黑暗，但是它仍放射着光芒。光之所在，黑暗尽除。

usePower.name: release absorbed darkness in a %d radius cone with a %d%% chance to blind (based on lite radius), dealing %0.2f darkness damage (based on Mindpower and charge)
usePower.nameZh: 在%d码的锥形范围内释放吸收的黑暗，有 %d%% 几率致盲（基于光照半径） , 并造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害 ( 基于精神强度和吸收量)

specialDesc.en: Absorbs all darkness (power %d, based on Willpower and Cunning) within its light radius, increasing its own brightness. (current charge %d).
specialDesc.zh: 在光照范围内吸收所有黑暗(强度 %d,基于意志和灵巧) 并增加亮度。(当前增幅： %d)。

artifacts.name: Un'fezan's Cap
artifacts.desc:
This fez once belonged to a traveler; it always seems to be found lying around in odd locations.
#{italic}#Fezzes are cool.#{normal}#
artifacts.descZh: 这顶土耳其毡帽曾经属于一位旅行家，他经常在奇怪的地方被人发现。#{italic}#帽子看上去很不错。#{normal}#

artifacts.name: Unbreakable Greaves
artifacts.desc: These titanic boots appear to have been carved from stone. They appear weathered and cracked, but easily deflect all blows.
artifacts.descZh: 这对巨大的靴子似乎是用石头雕刻而成的，尽管已经风化破裂，但仍旧能抵抗一切伤害。

artifacts.name: Unerring Scalpel
artifacts.desc: This scalpel was used by the dread sorcerer Kor'Pul when he began learning the necromantic arts in the Age of Dusk.  Many were the bodies, living and dead, that became unwilling victims of his terrible experiments.
artifacts.descZh: 这把解剖刀曾经被可怕的巫师卡·普尔在黄昏纪刚开始学习死灵法术时使用。许多人，生物和尸体都成为了他那可怕实验的牺牲品。

artifacts.name: Unflinching Eye
artifacts.desc: Someone has strung a thick black cord through this large bloodshot eyeball, allowing it to be worn around the neck, should you so choose.
artifacts.descZh: 有人用一条黑色的粗线穿过这颗充血的眼球，把它挂在脖子上。你也应该这样做。

artifacts.name: Unsetting Sun
artifacts.desc: When Elmio Panason, captain of the Vanguard, first sought shelter for his shipwrecked crew, he reflected the last rays of the setting sun off his shield.  Where the beam hit they rested and built the settlement that would become the Sunwall.  In the dark days that followed the shield became a symbol of hope for a better future.
artifacts.descZh: 当冲锋队队长艾米奥·帕纳森为他的遇难船员们寻求庇护所的时候，他的盾牌反射着落日的光辉。他们在光辉照耀的地方休息宿营，之后太阳堡垒在那里成立。在随后那些暗无天日的日子里，这面盾牌被人们当做美好未来希望的象征。

artifacts.name: Unstoppable Mauler
artifacts.desc: A huge greatmaul of incredible weight. Wielding it, you feel utterly unstoppable.
artifacts.descZh: 拥有难以想象重量的巨型大槌。挥舞它让你感觉势不可挡。

artifacts.name: Ureslak's Femur
artifacts.desc: A shortened femur of the mighty prismatic dragon Ureslak, this erratic club still resonates with his volatile nature.
artifacts.descZh: 强大的棱晶龙乌尔斯拉克被截断的腿骨，这根奇怪的棍子仍然流动着乌尔斯拉克的天性。

items.value: 10% chance to shimmer to a different hue and gain powers

artifacts.name: Ureslak's Focus
artifacts.desc: This cracked gemstone fell from the remains of the dead Ureslak. It appears to have been turned into a vibrant crystal in whatever process reanimated him.
artifacts.descZh: 这块有裂痕的宝石从已经死亡的巨龙乌瑞斯拉克身上掉下来。它似乎已经变成了纯粹的水晶体。

artifacts.name: Ureslak's Molted Scales
artifacts.desc: This cloak is fashioned from the scales of some large reptilian creature.  It appears to reflect every color of the rainbow.
artifacts.descZh: 这件长袍用某些大型爬行动物的鳞片制成。它看上去可以反射出彩虹的每种颜色。

usePower.name: energize the scales for 16 turns, increasing resistance to %s damage by 15%% just before you are damaged. (This effect lasts 5 turns and only works on one type of damage.)
usePower.nameZh: 为鳞片充能16回合，让你在受 %s 伤害前增加相应抗性15%%，持续5回合，只对一种伤害生效。

artifacts.name: Vargh Redemption
artifacts.desc: This azure ring seems to be always moist to the touch.
artifacts.descZh: 这个海蓝色的戒指看上去总是水汪汪的。

usePower.name: summon a radius %d tidal wave that expands slowly over %d turns, dealing %0.2f cold and %0.2f physical damage (based on Willpower) each turn, knocking opponents back, and lowering their stun resistance
usePower.nameZh: 召唤缓慢扩张的半径 %d 的潮汐，持续 %d 回合，每回合造成 %0.2f 寒冷和 %0.2f 物理伤害，击退敌人，并降低他们的震慑抗性。

artifacts.name: Vestments of the Conclave
artifacts.desc:
An ancient set of robes that has survived from the Age of Allure. Primal magic forces inhabit it.
It was made by Humans for Humans; only they can harness the true power of the robes.
artifacts.descZh: 这件古老的礼服从厄流纪保存了下来。上古的魔法力量占据着它。它由人类专门为人类制造；只有他们才能驾驭这件长袍的真正力量。

artifacts.name: Viletooth
artifacts.desc: This aged looking saw is very rusty, and you think you see a thin layer of... something... on its blades.
artifacts.descZh: 这个上了年头的链锯严重生锈，而且你发现锯刃上有一层薄薄的*东西*。

items.value: may infect the target with a random disease

artifacts.name: Vindicator
artifacts.desc: "Pesky undead plaguing your village? Necromancers ransacking your burial grounds? The Vindicator is the solution to all your woes!"
artifacts.descZh: 恼人的不死族在你的村庄传播瘟疫？死灵法师搜刮你的墓地？维序者可以解决一切。

items.value: release a burst of light dealing damage equal to your cunning plus your magic in a ball of radius 2. If the target is undead, the damage and radius are doubled.

artifacts.name: Visage of Nektosh
artifacts.desc: You always thought his horns looked kind of stupid, to be honest.
artifacts.descZh: 实话实说，你觉得他的角看上去有点蠢。

specialDesc.en: Increases your maximum stacks of Death Momentum by 1.
specialDesc.zh: 增加死亡波纹的上限1。

artifacts.name: Voice of Telos
artifacts.desc: A closer look at this pure white staff reveals that it is really a plethora of colors swirling and scintillating.
artifacts.descZh: 对这根纯净的白色法杖近距离欣赏会发现很多种颜色在上面盘旋闪耀。

artifacts.name: Void Orb
artifacts.desc: This thin grey ring is adorned with a deep black orb. Tiny white dots swirl slowly within it, and a faint purple light glows from its core.
artifacts.descZh: 这只戒指装饰有深黑色的水晶。仿佛有白色的星云在戒指上缭绕，水晶的核心处偶尔有紫色的光一闪而过。

artifacts.name: Void Quiver
artifacts.desc: An endless supply of arrows lay within this deep black quiver. Tiny white lights dot its surface.
artifacts.descZh: 这个深黑色的箭壶中可以源源不断的抽出箭矢，它的表面闪烁着点点微光。

artifacts.name: Void Shard
artifacts.desc: This jagged shape looks like a hole in space, yet it is solid, though light in weight.
artifacts.descZh: 这个锯齿状的影像看上去像是时空中的黑洞，但它又是固态的，尽管重量非常的轻。

usePower.name: release a radius %d burst of void energy at up to range %d, dealing %0.2f temporal and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic)
usePower.nameZh: 在 %d 码范围内释放虚空能量，至多距离 %d。造成 %0.2f 时空和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。(基于魔法)

artifacts.name: Void Star
artifacts.desc: It looks like a very tiny star -- deep black -- and yet it somehow shines.
artifacts.descZh: 它看起来像是一颗非常小巧的星星——深邃而黑暗——不时闪着光芒。

artifacts.name: Voratun Hammer of the Deep Bellow
artifacts.desc: The legendary hammer of the Dwarven master smiths. For ages it was used to forge powerful weapons with searing heat until it became highly powerful by itself.
artifacts.descZh: 矮人神匠的传奇铁锤。由于年复一年的在高温下打造强力的武器，自身也变的相当强力。

artifacts.name: Vox
artifacts.desc: No force can hope to silence the wearer of this amulet.
artifacts.descZh: 没有任何力量能使这个护身符的主人安静下来。

artifacts.name: Wanderer's Rest
artifacts.desc: These boots feel nearly completely weightless. Touching them, you feel an enormous burden lifted from you.
artifacts.descZh: 这双靴子几乎没有重量，触摸它，你觉得身上的重担一下子减轻了许多。

artifacts.name: Warmaster Gnarg's Murderblade
artifacts.nameZh: 战争之王格纳哥的饮血剑
artifacts.desc: A blood-etched greatsword, it has seen many foes. From the inside.
artifacts.descZh: 一把血迹斑斑的大剑，它洞穿了许多敌人。

items.value: 10% chance to send the wielder into a killing frenzy

artifacts.name: Wheel of Fate
artifacts.desc:
"This isn't what I wished for!" - Howar Muransk, Cornac demonologist.

This band of gothic obsidian menaces with an embossed image of a grinning skull. It beckons you to tempt fate and put it on. Do you?
artifacts.descZh:
这不是我想要的结果！- 豪瓦尔·穆朗斯，科纳克人恶魔使者。
狞笑着的骷髅图案在这个由黑曜石铸成的哥特式戒指上隐约浮现。骷髅似乎在召唤着你，使你情不自禁想要铤而走险地把它戴在手上，转动命运之轮。你会这么做吗？

usePower.name: re-generate the item with random stats. Can only be done three levels after the last reroll. Cannot be unequipped unless a reroll is available, or you are level 50
usePower.nameZh: 重置戒指属性。每3级能重置一次。除非有重置机会或者人物50级，否则不能解除装备。

artifacts.name: Whip of Urh'Rok
artifacts.desc: With this unbearably bright whip of flame, the demon master Urh'Rok has become known for never having lost in combat.
artifacts.descZh: 用这根炽焰打造的鞭子，恶魔领主乌鲁洛克未尝一败。

artifacts.name: Whipsnap
artifacts.desc: "Sick of your pesky enemies hitting you with weapons? Well, with the new spring loaded Whipsnap, you can quickly put a stop to that!"
artifacts.descZh: 你是否已经厌倦了恼人的敌人用武器攻击你？那么，使用装载了弹簧的鞭笞，你可以迅速制止这一切！

artifacts.name: Will of Ul'Gruth
artifacts.desc: These massive gauntlets once belonged to a very powerful demon named Ul'Gruth. The behemoth was said to be able to level entire buildings with a single swing of his hands.
artifacts.descZh: 这双巨大的手套曾经属于一个名叫乌尔格鲁斯的强大的恶魔。据说，这个怪物一挥手就能将一座城市夷为平地。

specialDesc.en: Your Obliterating Smash can destroy walls.
specialDesc.zh: 你的歼灭挥斩能摧毁墙壁

artifacts.name: Wind Worn Shot
artifacts.desc: These perfectly white spheres appear to have been worn down by years of exposure to strong winds.
artifacts.descZh: 这些白色的弹丸似乎饱经风霜。

items.value: 35% chance for lightning to arc to a second target

artifacts.name: Wind's Whisper
artifacts.desc: When the enchanter Razeen was cornered by Spellhunters near the Daikara mountain pass she wrapped her cloak about her and fled down a narrow ravine.  The hunters fired volley after volley of arrows at her, but by miracle or magic they all missed.  Razeen was able to escape and flee to the hidden city in the west.
artifacts.descZh: 当魔法师瑞兹恩被猎魔人在岱卡拉的山隘逼入绝境时，她用斗篷包裹着自己逃下了峡谷。猎手们接连不断的把箭射向她，但由于奇迹或是魔法，他们全部射空了。瑞兹恩得以逃生并躲进了西部的隐秘之城。

artifacts.name: Windborne Azurite
artifacts.desc: Air currents swirl around this bright blue jewel.
artifacts.descZh: 空气在这块亮蓝色宝石周围旋转。

artifacts.name: Wintertide
artifacts.desc:
The air seems to freeze around the blade of this sword, draining all heat from the area.
It is said the Conclave created this weapon for their warmaster during the dark times of the first allure war.
artifacts.descZh:
这把剑带给这片区域无尽的寒冷，剑锋周围的空气似乎都要凝固了。
据说是第一次厄流纪大战期间，孔克雷夫大师为他们的战争之王所打造。

usePower.name: precipitate ice walls (lasting 10 turns) within your Winter Storm's area
usePower.nameZh: 强化冰风暴的冰雪，冻结成冰墙，持续 10 回合。

specialDesc.en: No Winter Storm Active
specialDesc.zh: 没有寒冰风暴

artifacts.name: Wintertide Phial
artifacts.desc: This phial seems filled with darkness, yet it cleanses your thoughts.
artifacts.descZh: 这个小瓶子似乎充满了黑暗，但却净化了你的思想。

usePower.name: cleanse your mind of up to %d (based on Magic) detrimental mental effects
usePower.nameZh: 净化你的思想，解除至多%d个（基于魔法）负面精神状态。

artifacts.name: Witch-Bane
artifacts.desc:
A thin voratun blade with an ivory handle wrapped in purple cloth.  The weapon is nearly as legendary as its former owner, Marcus Dunn, and was thought to have been destroyed after Marcus was slain near the end of the Spellhunt.
It seems somebody well versed in antimagic could use it to its fullest potential.
artifacts.descZh:
一把沃瑞钽长剑，象牙的剑柄被紫色的布包裹着。这把兵器的传奇性跟它上一任拥有者玛库斯·丹差不多了，人们都以为这把剑在魔法狩猎末期玛库斯被害的时候被摧毁了。
据说只有将全身心奉献给反魔法事业的人才能充分发挥它的力量。

artifacts.name: Withering Orbs
artifacts.desc:
These opalescent orbs stare at you with deathly knowledge, undeceived by your vanities and pretences.  They have lived and died through horrors you could never imagine, and now they lie strung in black chords watching every twitch of the shadows.
If you close your eyes a moment, you can almost imagine what dread sights they see...
artifacts.descZh: 这些泛着乳白色光芒的眼球用死亡的眼神看着你，你的虚荣和虚伪使其苏醒。他们曾经在难以想象的恐惧中死亡，现在它们被黑色的丝线串起，周围缠绕着片片阴影。如果你闭上眼睛一段时间，你甚至可以感受到它们曾经看到的恐怖画面……

artifacts.name: Worm Nest
artifacts.desc: This unusually thick robe constantly wriggles and squirms. Small worms sometimes pop out of it, dropping to the floor. The worms will cushion attacks against your person, but you somehow do not like the idea of having so many parasitic creatures so close to your vulnerable flesh.
artifacts.descZh: 这件异常厚重的长袍不断蠕动。上面的小蠕虫有时会从上面跳出来，掉到地板上。这些蠕虫会缓冲敌人对你的攻击，但是让这这么多寄生生物如此接近你脆弱的肉体…实在是太恶心了

artifacts.name: Wrap of Stone
artifacts.desc: This thick cloak is incredibly tough, yet bends and flows with ease.
artifacts.descZh: 尽管这件石头斗篷又硬又厚，但是你仍能轻松地折叠它。

artifacts.name: Wrathroot's Barkwood
artifacts.desc: The barkwood of Wrathroot, made into roughly the shape of a shield.
artifacts.descZh: 用狂怒树精的树皮制成的粗糙盾牌。

artifacts.name: Writhing Essence of Nightmares
artifacts.desc: Whispers seem to ceaselessly emanate from this writhing mass of black tentacles, murmuring unspeakable horrors into the ears of any unfortunate enough to hear them.
artifacts.descZh: 从这黑色触须的扭动似乎中不停地发出耳语，对任何不幸听到的人带来难以言喻的恐惧。

artifacts.name: Writhing Ring of the Hunter
artifacts.desc: A writhing mass of tentacles roughtly warped into the form of a ring. A dark malovelant power emanates from it.
artifacts.descZh: 大量扭曲的触须弯曲成了指环的形状。一团黑暗的恶意力量从里面散发出来

specialDesc.en: When first worn the ring attunes to you, letting you choose a prodigy it will forever grant while worn (can not be changed once chosen, re-wear it to select again if you refused to choose at first).
specialDesc.zh: 当你第一次戴上戒指的时候，选择一个觉醒技能，你将在戴上这个戒指的时候获得这个觉醒技能（一旦选择就不能改变。如果你第一次没有选择，可以在重新装备的时候进行选择）

artifacts.name: Wyrmbreath
artifacts.desc: These dragon scale gloves are tipped with the claws and teeth of a vicious Wyrm. The gloves are warm to the touch.
artifacts.descZh: 这件龙鳞手套上嵌着一条恶龙的牙齿与爪子。手套摸上去十分温暖。

artifacts.name: X-Ray Goggles
artifacts.desc: How do these even work?
artifacts.descZh: 这玩意到底怎么用?

usePower.name: see everything. EVERYTHING. For 5 turns, anyway
usePower.nameZh: 看到所有东西。*所有东西*。当然，只有5回合。

artifacts.name: Yaldan Baoth
artifacts.desc: The golden bascinet crown, affiliated with Veluca of Yaldan. King of the mythical city of Yaldan, that was struck from the face of Eyal by the arrogance of its people. Lone survivor of his kin, he spent his last years wandering the early world, teaching man to stand against the darkness. With his dying words, "Fear no evil", the crown was passed onto his successor.
artifacts.descZh: 这顶金色的王冠属于传说之城雅尔丹之王——Veluca。【待翻译】他比他的任何亲戚活得都长，在生命的最后日子里，他行走在早期的世界上，教育人们反抗黑暗。临死前，这顶王冠交给了他的继任者，一同交付的还有他的遗言——勿惧邪恶

usePower.name: lower the helmet's visor, blinding yourself (and protecting from other blinds) for 6 turns. If the helmet is taken off, the effect will end early.
usePower.nameZh: 降低头盔的视野，使你致盲6回合并免疫其他致盲效果6回合。如果脱下这件装备，致盲效果会提前结束。

artifacts.name: Yeek-fur Robe
artifacts.desc: A beautifully soft robe of fine white fur. It looks designed for a halfling noble, with glorious sapphires sewn across the hems. But entrancing as it is, you can't help but feel a little queasy wearing it.
artifacts.descZh: 美丽、柔软、洁白，这显然是为半身人贵族设计的衣物，褶边上还缀着几颗明亮的蓝宝石。尽管它是如此迷人，当你披上它时却忍不住有些恶心。

artifacts.name: Yeti Mind Controller
artifacts.desc: This device seems to be designed to 'hack' the mind of a wild yeti to make it able to be used as a weapon of war.
artifacts.descZh: 该装置用于设计攻击雪人族的大脑，将其作为战争武器。

usePower.name: hack the mind of a weakened yeti
usePower.nameZh: 操纵虚弱雪人的思维。

artifacts.name: Yeti-fur Cloak
artifacts.desc: This fur cloak is thick and matted, yet remains incredibly soft to the touch.
artifacts.descZh: 这件毛皮斗篷厚重且暗淡无光，但是摸起来却不可思议的柔软。

artifacts.name: Zemekkys' Broken Hourglass
artifacts.desc: This small broken hourglass hangs from a thin gold chain.  The glass is cracked and the sand has long since escaped.
artifacts.descZh: 这个坏掉的小沙漏系在一根金子做的细链上。沙漏的玻璃被打破了，里面的沙子早就掉光了。
